jobs.description:
People Partner

Hello, I’m Danielle, Senior Director, People Experience at Customer.io! We're expanding our people team in the United States and seeking a People Partner to support our global team in a fast-paced, innovative environment. This is a great fit for an HR professional with a few years of experience who's ready to deepen their impact as a partner to the business.

The People Partners at Customer.io are advocates for our people, leveraging their skills in data analytics, change management, and industry knowledge. They use these skills to enhance Customer.io’s transformation, agility, and efficiency, delivering meaningful outcomes for both our team members and the business.

You'll work alongside a cross-functional team to support talent management, development, retention, and organizational effectiveness. Strong communication, critical thinking, and a foundation in workforce planning will set you up for success. If you're passionate about contributing to a supportive, high-performing culture, we'd love for you to join our collaborative team.

About Customer.io

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Some things you'll do:

  • Support business alignment: Partner with departmental leaders to understand business needs and help develop plans that build organizational capabilities and support growth.
  • Performance management: Own and elevate our review cycles end to end — lead the annual and bi-annual processes, guide calibration and compensation decisions, and coach managers to build accountability and develop talent across the team.
  • Employee relations: Guide managers and employees through day-to-day questions and concerns with fairness and sound judgment, fostering a positive, respectful work environment.
  • Organizational development: Help assess team structures and work with leaders to identify areas for improvement and put changes into practice.
  • Change management support: Support organizational change efforts and help build change-readiness across teams.
  • Leadership support: Build strong working relationships with managers to understand their needs in the context of business goals, and provide day-to-day partnership and guidance.
  • Data analysis: Review and analyze People metrics and analytics (including employee experience and lifecycle data) to spot trends and support informed decisions.
  • Employee engagement: Work with leaders to roll out engagement initiatives.
  • People programs support: Help develop and implement people programs that foster employee growth and development.
  • People team support: Be an active member of the People Experience team, contributing to strong HR capabilities.

About you:

  • You're a self-starter with strong communication and presentation skills.
  • You've got a knack for creative problem solving and avoid a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • You're a champion for change, supporting leaders and employees through change initiatives.
  • You care about employee engagement, team members' well-being, and DEIB, and are eager to help build programs that support them.
  • You understand the importance of tailoring programs, strategies, and suggestions to fit different needs.
  • You're agile and adaptable, with a growth mindset for learning new skills.

What we're looking for:

  • HR Experience: 5+ years of progressive HR/People experience, ideally as an HRBP or People Partner supporting multiple teams or functions. You bring real depth across organizational design, change management, performance management, DEIB, culture championing, coaching and development, and people programs such as rewards and recognition. A strong foundation in People data and analytics — using metrics to diagnose issues and drive decisions — is especially important for this role.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to understand performance objectives that drive business outcomes, and to leverage data and analytics to support informed business decisions.
  • Experience with Management: Experience partnering with leaders and demonstrating influence and accountability in support of the people agenda.
  • Global Perspective: Ability to establish trust, fairness, and credibility with team members, managers, and cross-functional partners in a global environment.
  • Collaborative Problem Solver: Ability to work seamlessly with key partners across the People Team, including Recruiting, People Operations, and Total Rewards.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package between $100k - $130k USD, subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter
  2. 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager
  3. 45-minute video call with the Business Leader, Compensation Leader and 2 People Partner Team Members
  4. Take-Home Assignment + 60-minute Panel Presentation with the People Team Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We are passionate about our core values of Empathy, Transparency, Responsibility, and Awkwardness and are looking for new coworkers to share and build that passion!

jobs.excerpt: Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) About ToastToast builds technology that helps food and beverage businesses run smoother, serve customers better, and grow with confidence.
jobs.description:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid)

About Toast

Toast builds technology that helps food and beverage businesses run smoother, serve customers better, and grow with confidence. Our platform brings together the tools teams need to power daily operations—while turning complexity into clear, actionable insights. We're purpose-built for the pace of hospitality, and we're investing in new experiences that make great businesses easier to run at any scale.

About this role* (responsibilities)

We're looking for a Design Engineer to join our New Ventures team—someone who lives at the intersection of design and code. You'll design, prototype, and ship the experiences that bring Toast's newest products to life, from fuzzy early concept through MVP and iteration.

This is a hands-on building role. You think like a designer and build like an engineer, and you're expected to write production-quality front-end code—not just prototypes. Comfort across the full stack is a strong plus. Above all, you use AI tools to move fast, explore broadly, prototype convincingly, and continuously test ideas to create amazing user experiences.

We're looking for someone who is amazing at the craft of design and can turn that craft into real, shippable software. You think in terms of user flows, not screens. You draw on analogous problem spaces to find creative, unexpected ways to make an experience delightful. You're exceptionally strong at translating complexity—high volumes of data points, operational constraints, edge cases, and intricate rules—into UIs that feel intuitive and calm. And you take those designs all the way to working, maintainable front-end code.

In this role, you will:

  • Own design and front-end engineering for one of Toast's new ventures—from fuzzy early concepts to shippable, high-quality production experiences.
  • Write clean, maintainable front-end code, owning the quality of the experience end-to-end. We're scrappy and fast—we don't polish every pixel for its own sake—but the experience always needs to feel great, considered, and intentional where it counts.
  • Use AI tools to iterate quickly: generate and compare concepts, accelerate exploration, and bring workflows to life through rapid prototyping and coding in hours, not days.
  • Design information-dense experiences that are still highly scannable and decision-oriented—prioritizing hierarchy, progressive disclosure, and clear actions.
  • Create prototypes that feel real—clickable, coded flows and interaction models that help product and engineering make decisions fast, and that get you from 90% to 100%.
  • Make smart trade offs under constraints—move fast with MVP patterns, while sweating the details that matter most (hierarchy, states, error handling, accessibility, performance, and clarity).
  • Run with a bias for action and testing: quickly validate assumptions via low-fi experiments, coded prototypes, usability testing, dogfooding, and iterative refinement.
  • Operate autonomously: set your own plan, seek input when needed, and keep momentum without waiting for perfect clarity—while collaborating closely with a small team.
  • Communicate clearly: tell the story of what you're building, why it matters, and what you learned—through working prototypes, artifacts, demos, and written narratives.

Do you have the right ingredients?* (requirements)

  • You're equally comfortable designing and building and you ship real front-end code, not just mockups.
  • Strong front-end engineering skills: you can build production-quality UI, and you care about maintainability, performance, and accessibility. (Fullstack experience is a strong plus.)
  • Amazing at the craft of design: you think in user flows, borrow from analogous problem spaces to invent delightful solutions, and know instinctively where an experience needs to shine versus where scrappy is good enough.
  • Demonstrated ability to move from ambiguity to a strong point of view, then turn that into tangible, coded UI flows quickly with modern tools.
  • Demonstrated strength translating complex workflows and high volumes of inputs/data into interfaces that are simple, scannable, and decision-oriented.
  • Strong product thinking: you can connect user needs, business outcomes, and feasibility into a cohesive experience.
  • You think in systems and can build reusable, maintainable UI components.
  • High comfort working in 0→1 environments where priorities shift, learning is the output, and "done" is an iteration—not a finish line.
  • Ability to work as a team-of-one design engineer: self-directed, organized, and proactive about aligning stakeholders.
  • You have a clear pattern of using AI tools to accelerate your work—exploration, iteration, prototyping, coding, critique, synthesis, or communication—and you can speak specifically about how you use them to ship better work faster.

Special sauce* (nice to haves)

  • You've worked on early-stage products, internal incubations, or rapid experimentation teams.
  • You've shipped polished products and have a portfolio (and ideally code) you can point to and say "I designed and built that."
  • Fullstack range—you're comfortable owning backend, APIs, or data work in addition to the front end.
  • You're excited about AI and want to help define new interaction paradigms for how hospitality businesses run.
  • Background in design or formal design training, alongside your engineering chops.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at .

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. To learn more:

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region:

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse, and we embrace that diversity with authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and humility. By embedding these principles into our culture and design, we create equitable opportunities for all and raise the bar in delivering exceptional experiences.

We Thrive Together

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the restaurant community. To learn more about how we work globally and regionally, check out: .

jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a Senior Project Controls Analyst (Cost Engineer) to execute day-to-day project controls activities across a wide portfolio oil, gas, and remediation projects, ensuring cost performance, financial accuracy, and project transparency throughout the project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work closely with Project Managers to develop and maintain cost-loaded schedules, perform financial forecasting, track project performance, manage annual budget forecasts, and support project reporting. You will play a critical role in delivering accurate cost management, earned value analysis, and forecasting while ensuring alignment with organizational standards and project objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Utilize company project controls systems and tools to monitor, analyze, and report project cost performance.
  • Develop, maintain, and update project cost forecasts, budgets, and cost-loaded schedules.
  • Partner with Project Managers and project teams to identify, evaluate, and mitigate cost and schedule risks.
  • Analyze financial data and performance metrics to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare cost forecasts, variance analyses, expenditure forecasts, and progress trend reports.
  • Perform earned value management (EVM) analysis and monitor project performance against established baselines.
  • Evaluate labor, manpower, and resource requirements against budget limitations and project commitments.
  • Review project expenditures, purchase orders, subcontract commitments, and contractor invoices to ensure alignment with approved budgets and work authorizations.
  • Support scope control and change management processes, including tracking and reporting the status of change orders.
  • Develop and maintain cost and schedule baseline budgets and support cost/schedule integration activities.
  • Conduct critical path and schedule impact analyses to support project planning and forecasting efforts.
  • Prepare and deliver project controls reports for management and stakeholders.
  • Participate in and, when required, lead project cost review meetings.
  • Assist with the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of project controls procedures and best practices.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior project controls staff as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 6 years of relevant experience, or demonstrated equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting engineering, construction, energy, environmental, or infrastructure projects.
  • Proficiency with project controls, cost management, scheduling, and forecasting methodologies.
  • Experience with earned value management, cost forecasting, and project financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Project and other project controls software.
  • Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
  • Employment is contingent upon successfully passing a pre-employment drug screen.

jobs.description:
Volunteer Mentor - Arden Careers & Employability (ACE) Mentoring Programme

Programme: Arden Careers & Employability (ACE) Mentoring

Department: Careers, Employability, Enterprise & Alumni

Employment Type: Voluntary (non-remunerated)

Location: Remote (online)

Term:6 Months (renewable for future cohorts)

Time Commitment: Approx. 1-2 hours a month (minimum 4 x online meetings + ad-hoc support as required)

Click here to read thefull role description

About the Opportunity:

Arden University runs the 'ACE Mentoring Programme' to help close gaps in progression and improve graduate outcomes for students from priority groups. As part of our Access & Participation Plan, this initiative connects current students/recent graduates with industry professionals and/or Arden alumni for structured, online career mentoring.

As a volunteer mentor, you’ll share your industry expertise and professional insight to help students build confidence, develop employability skills, and progress into meaningful work or further study through clear, achievable career plans.

You’ll be matched with mentee(s) from priority groups, including:

  • Students from ethnic minority backgrounds

  • Students with disabilities (including mental health conditions)

  • Students who are care experienced

Mentoring takes place online via our approved 3rd party mentoring platform, Mentorloop. You’ll receive training and support to help you get started and make the most of the experience.

Programme Timings:

The programme runs from Autumn 2026 to Spring 2027 over a period of 6 months. All mentoring conversations and meetings take place online meaning the schedule is flexible. We ask mentors to commit approximately 1–2 hours per month, including ad-hoc support between mentoring sessions. We recommend holding a meeting roughly every 4 weeks, but this may be more or less frequent, depending on your availability and how often your mentee wishes to meet.

What we are looking for:

We welcome professionals from all sectors and backgrounds who have at least 2 years professional experience in graduate or management level employment. You don’t need prior mentoring experience, just a genuine interest in supporting students and the ability to share practical career insight. Ideal mentors will be:

  • Enthusiastic and committed to the idea of mentoring to support students from a wide range of backgrounds.

  • Willing to help others develop and succeed by sharing real industry insights and personal experience.

  • Strong communicators who can offer encouragement and constructive feedback

  • Respectful, inclusive, open-minded and able to mentor without judgement, bias or discrimination.

  • Relevant professional experience in any sector including self-employment, with the ability to share insights and networks.

About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a principal engineer to join our Streaming Systems team, leading work on the high-throughput systems that collect, forward, and perform realtime computation on billions of behavioral events from our customer’s users. You'll be building the infrastructure that ingests clickstream, product interaction, and transactional data into our platform. This data is the platform for our “Cursor for Marketers” AI agent product.

Our streaming products’ revenue has 10x’d over the past year, and we need to ensure that we continue to scale. Our infrastructure needs to handle millions of messages per second at single second latency end to end. Recently, we added a computation engine that allows personalizing user experiences in real-time based on live behavior; we’re seeing 7-figure market response in the first few months and need to scale up to meet demand.

We are building new products from scratch, so we need someone who enjoys greenfield work and leading other engineers. Some of the problems you’d work on include:

  1. Preserving <1s end to end system latency at throughput over 1,000,000 messages / second.
  2. Improving caching strategies for our online computation service
  3. Architecting a system that can deduplicate message delivery at 1,000,000 messages / second.
  4. Patterns for elegant and zero-downtime deployments in our online computation service

We believe in enabling our engineers to do their best work for our customers by giving them extremely high levels of ownership and autonomy. You will own and deliver projects from start to finish, work directly with customers to solve their hardest scaling problems, and have significant influence over our technical roadmap.

The base salary range for this position is $180,000 - $400,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. A large portion of the compensation will be in the form of equity via ISO options. We offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window.

About You

  • You are an experienced engineer with a passion for solving hard technical problems that generate real value for customers. You’re motivated by high ownership and are comfortable in a fast-paced, startup environment. You have experience leading highly complex and ambitious projects, and want to mentor and up level engineers around you.
  • You have experience architecting, building, deploying, and maintaining distributed systems at scale, and can broadcast and encourage technical excellence in doing so.
  • You have opinions about how engineering should be done, and want to help scale a rapidly growing engineering team.

Interview Process

Our goal with the interview process is to balance speed with giving both parties opportunities to assess whether there is a strong mutual fit. We will ask you questions, but we want you to ask us questions! Our technical interviews focus on how you design systems because we believe this is the best way for us to see how you work and for you to see how we collaborate. We don’t ask you to write code to solve technical brainteasers that don’t appear in your day to day job.

  • Apply: Curl jobapi.hightouchdata.com on port 13784 and have followed those instructions before applying. It'll only take a minute!
  • Recruiter Screen [30m]: Introductory call with our recruiting team to get to know each other and see if the role could be a good mutual fit.
  • System Design Screen [45m]: Designing a data processing feature end-to-end.
  • Hiring Manager Interview [30m]: Chat with hiring manager about past experiences and future operating preferences to assess fit on company values and operating principles.
  • System Design Interview [90m]: Work with the interviewer to architect a system at a conceptual level. The problem will be at a pretty high level - and have both product and customer requirements as well as technical.
  • Execution and Impact [60m]: Pick a project you lead and prepare to give the interviewer a walk through. Then deep dive and answer questions about the project execution and how you lead it.

We have limited inbound applications to one application per candidate. You will be auto-rejected if you apply to multiple roles. Please only apply to the position you are most qualified for.

E-Verify Statement

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team

The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.

About the role

Compliance Shared Services delivers the horizontal capabilities that power Affirm's consumer compliance program: regulatory compliance monitoring, compliance data analytics, issues management, compliance training, regulatory change management, and bank partner audit and exam support. The team sits in the second line of defense and partners across Compliance, Legal, Engineering, Product, Internal Audit, and our bank partners to ensure obligations are monitored, exceptions are investigated and remediated, and evidence stands up to regulator and auditor scrutiny.

As the Analytics Lead, Strategic Insights for Compliance Shared Services, you will own the compliance analytics and automated monitoring function for a multi-product, multi-partner consumer lending business. The work requires fluency in both regulation and data, and it runs in both directions: you translate regulatory obligations into automated, evidence-producing data checks, and you translate data anomalies back into clear regulatory answers.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Compliance Programs, and operate as the senior individual contributor for the analytics function. A supporting data analyst carries much of the recurring execution workload; you will provide that analyst with day-to-day technical direction, structured training, and quality review while you focus on monitoring design, examination data ownership, exception judgment, and automation.

The outputs of this role are consumed by state regulators, bank partners, internal and external auditors, and senior leadership. The quality bar is evidence-grade and reproducible, and the operating rhythm combines a steady weekly monitoring cadence with high-intensity examination and incident surges that arrive on external timelines.

What you'll do

  • Own the design, operation, and governance of automated compliance monitoring: translate regulatory obligations into rule-based detective controls that run on defined frequencies, surface exceptions, and produce audit-ready evidence.

  • Serve as the primary data owner for regulatory examinations, licensing audits, and bank partner exam requests: scope requests into defined populations and extraction logic, validate results across source systems, document methodology and assumptions, and support responses through multi-round follow-ups under external deadlines.

  • Triage monitoring exceptions and data anomalies, distinguishing true compliance exceptions from data artifacts and process gaps, route findings to the appropriate resolution path, and support remediation through validation and evidence review.

  • Map automated checks to specific regulatory requirements, converting query logic into control statements that feed the compliance control inventory and close the loop between monitoring exceptions and tracked compliance issues.

  • Drive the automation roadmap: identify recurring manual reporting and repeat data requests and convert them into automated pipelines and self-service tools, applying AI-assisted development with disciplined human-in-the-loop validation.

  • Steward the compliance data environment: adjudicate source-of-truth questions, resolve data access and quality constraints, and maintain the query repository, runbooks, and methodology documentation.

  • Provide day-to-day technical direction, structured onboarding and training, work prioritization, and quality review for a supporting data analyst, coaching for independence and end-to-end ownership.

  • Partner with Engineering, Legal, Product, Internal Audit, and bank partners to resolve data definition and quality questions, and expand monitoring coverage across new products, requirements, and jurisdictions.

What we look for

  • 5+ years in compliance analytics, monitoring or surveillance, transaction testing, audit analytics, or a comparable data role in consumer lending, banking, fintech, or another regulated industry.

  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack such as Snowflake and Databricks, including building and operating automated pipelines, dashboards, and data quality checks.

  • Working knowledge of consumer credit regulations such as TILA/Reg Z, ECOA/Reg B, EFTA/Reg E, FCRA, SCRA, MLA, TCPA, and state lending, licensing, and usury requirements, and the ability to convert those obligations into data logic.

  • Bidirectional fluency: you read a regulation and know the data question it implies, and you read a data anomaly and know the regulatory question it raises.

  • Evidence-grade rigor: you reconcile, validate, reproduce, and document your work so it stands up to examiners and auditors, and you have delivered regulatory or audit data under hard deadlines with multi-round follow-ups.

  • AI fluency: you use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate query building, troubleshooting, and workflow automation, and you validate outputs before relying on them.

  • Experience training, guiding, or reviewing the work of junior analysts, with the judgment to coach for independence rather than absorb the work yourself.

  • A builder disposition: comfort with ambiguity, self-directed prioritization, and clear written and verbal communication that translates technical findings for legal, compliance, and executive audiences.

  • Nice to Have

    • Lightweight application development (Streamlit or similar) and Python.

    • GRC platform exposure (AuditBoard or similar) and control inventory or control documentation experience.

    • Familiarity with bank partnership or sponsor bank operating models.

    • Experience expanding monitoring or reporting coverage across jurisdictions (US, Canada, UK).

Base Pay Grade - K

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $145,000 - $205,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $128,000 - $188,000

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

SALES REPRESENTATIVE | Fractional | Remote | Full-Time | $180,000 OTE (Uncapped)

About Fractional

Fractional is redefining how operators raise capital. Instead of the slow, expensive syndication or fund model, operators use Fractional to launch investment clubs, pooling capital and resources from their friends, network, or audience, with legal structure, compliance, and back-office operations handled automatically. Co-developed with the former Senior Counsel of the SEC, Fractional is a Series A fintech company backed by Fifth Wall (the largest real estate VC in the world), Y Combinator, Will Smith, and Kevin Durant, and trusted by top operators like Pace Morby, Brandon Brittingham, and Carlos Reyes.

We move fast. New scripts, new plays, new features get tested and shipped in weeks, not quarters. This is a lean, high-output team, and sales sits at the center of our growth.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Sales Representative to help operators understand how Fractional scales their ability to raise capital and grow their business. This is a warm inbound seat, not a cold-calling grind. You'll get roughly 100+ qualified leads a month from ads, conferences, and community partnerships, and your job is to convert them.

You'll run consultative, video-based discovery calls with sophisticated buyers: operators, founders, and fund managers. You'll present the Fractional model, handle real objections around compliance and structure, and close high-ticket deals, sometimes on the first call, sometimes over a multi-call cycle. You'll be coached hard by a dedicated sales coach every week and expected to improve fast. If you thrive on direct feedback and want to see your close rate climb month over month, this is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Run consultative, discovery-led video calls with operators, founders, fund managers, and other sophisticated prospects, walking them through a live platform demo tailored to their situation
  • Ask for the sale, directly and without hesitation
  • Own a multi-call sales cycle from first conversation to close, including follow-up and re-nurture of your full pipeline
  • Confidently explain a complex, compliance-heavy product, and know when to loop in the team for technical or legal depth
  • Work reactivation and dormant pipeline alongside new inbound leads
  • Track and hit activity and close-rate targets, and be ready to talk specifics on your numbers
  • Take coaching seriously and apply it on the very next call

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 3+ years closing high-ticket B2B deals ($5K+ deal size), with a real, specific close rate you can talk through in detail
  • Experience with multi-call, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the instinct to know when to go for the one-call close
  • A track record selling to sophisticated buyers, not mass-market consumers, and the confidence to hold your own in that conversation
  • Follow-up discipline. Nothing sits in your pipeline without a next step and a reason for it
  • The ability to get up to speed fast on a complex product and industry, and explain it simply, even while a sharp prospect is stress-testing you live
  • A discovery-first mindset. You ask more than you tell, and you don't rush to solve before you understand the prospect
  • Coachability. You take feedback well and don't get defensive when a call gets picked apart
  • High energy, real conviction on the phone, and a genuine hunger to grind in a startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Background in real estate, business acquisitions, finance, or capital markets
  • Experience in syndications, fund administration, private equity, or fintech

What Makes This Different

Your leads are booked for you. You're not prospecting, you're selling. You'll work directly with a sales coach every week, on scripts, call reviews, and follow-up systems built to help you close more, faster. And your upside is uncapped: our top performer is on pace to clear well over $300K this year.

This Role Is NOT For You If...

  • You need a fully mapped-out script before you can perform
  • You're used to mass-market, low-ticket, transactional sales
  • You wait for the buyer to ask before you go for the close
  • You get defensive when a call gets picked apart in review
  • You're looking for a standard 9-to-5

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits

  • $72,000 base + uncapped commission ($108,000 target) | OTE $180,000, top performers clear $330,000+
  • Paid monthly with a quarterly true-up
  • Company health insurance
  • Fully remote, work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Direct weekly coaching from a dedicated sales coach, plus hands-on mentorship from our CEO

How to Apply

Submit your application and complete all screening questions. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Qualified applicants will be contacted by the recruiting team regarding next steps.

Strategy & Leadership

Data Analytics Capability Coach (Level 4)

Reports to: Delivery Director

About Corndel

Corndel is a unique, multi award-winning UK management and technology training provider that focuses on delivering the highest quality programmes throughout an employee’s career. We partner with some of the UK’s largest and most exciting businesses to help drive organisational and personal performance through transformational learning. Our vision is to shape a world where everyone is empowered to be their professional best. We are one of the fastest growing companies in the UK and provide a great platform for proactive and motivated individuals to take the next exciting step in their career. You will be joining an organisation with a fun, entrepreneurial and supportive environment, providing fulfilling work and an open, informal culture.

Purpose of the Role

The DA4 Coach (Data Analyst) exists to help learners develop the technical capability, judgement, and confidence to turn data into insight and action.

In this role, you will coach, mentor, and teach learners on Corndel’s Level 4 Data Analyst programme, supporting them to move beyond descriptive reporting to deeper analysis, interpretation, and decisionmaking. You will help learners understand not just how to analyse data, but why it matters, how to communicate insight responsibly, and how to apply sound professional judgement in real organisational contexts.

You will combine strong analytical expertise with a coaching mindset — empowering learners to take ownership of their development and apply data ethically and effectively in their roles.

Core Responsibilities

Learner Coaching & Development

  • Manage a caseload of learners, building trusted relationships through highquality coaching, mentoring, and structured teaching.

  • Deliver engaging onetoone sessions and workshops that make analytical concepts accessible, relevant, and practical.

  • Create an inclusive, psychologically safe learning environment where learners feel confident asking questions, testing ideas, and learning from mistakes.

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Support learners to develop core analytical skills, including data preparation, querying, analysis, modelling, and visualisation.

  • Coach learners to use tools such as Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python, and related platforms to generate meaningful insights.

  • Help learners interpret and communicate analysis clearly, linking insight to business questions and decisions.

  • Model integrity and professional judgement in how data is analysed, interpreted, and presented, including awareness of data quality, bias, and ethical considerations.

Progress, Quality & Outcomes

  • Guide learners through programme milestones, assessments, and portfolio development, ensuring consistent progress and timely completion.

  • Support learners to produce highquality, compliant evidence that genuinely reflects their analytical capability and workplace impact.

  • Engage constructively with learners’ line managers to align learning with organisational priorities and projects.

  • Take ownership for quality and compliance, balancing learner support with high standards and clear expectations.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across Operations, Product, and Curriculum to deliver a consistent and high-quality learner experience.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve delivery approaches, learner engagement, and outcomes.

  • Stay curious and committed to continuous development, keeping up to date with analytical tools, techniques, and best practice.

Technical Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Practical experience working in a data analytics role or similar analytical context.

  • Strong working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and analysis techniques.

  • Experience using Power BI or similar tools to analyse data and create clear, intuitive visualisations.

  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying and manipulating data.

  • Familiarity with predictive or statistical modelling concepts.

  • Experience coaching, mentoring, teaching, or facilitating learning in a professional environment.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical concepts clearly to learners with varied confidence levels.

  • Experience using Python and Jupyter Notebooks for data analysis.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Power Query

Desirable

· Digital engagement tools including Miro, Whiteboard

· Google Suite Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Looker and BIGQUERY

  • Alteryx user

  • Experience supporting learners in apprenticeship or vocational learning contexts.

  • Teaching or coaching qualifications, or experience delivering structured learning.

What Success in This Role Looks Like

In this role, success means that you:

  • Consistently support learners to complete their programme and End Point Assessment successfully and on time.

  • Are trusted by learners as a knowledgeable, supportive, and approachable expert.

  • Enable learners to apply analytical techniques confidently to inform decisions and create business impact.

  • Maintain high standards of quality, professionalism, and learner care.

  • Contribute positively to a collaborative, inclusive, and highperforming team culture.

What Brilliant Looks Like

At its best, this role creates impact beyond individual learners:

  • Learners describe your support as pivotal in developing their confidence and analytical judgement.

  • You help learners move from reporting data to influencing decisions and action.

  • You challenge learners constructively, improving the quality of their thinking rather than just their outputs.

  • You spot patterns across cohorts and proactively improve learner experience and outcomes.

  • Your influence supports organisations to use data more responsibly, insightfully, and effectively.

Who This Role Is For

This role is ideal for a data analyst or analytics professional who:

  • Enjoys helping others develop analytical confidence and capability.

  • Believes strong data practice combines technical skill with judgement and integrity.

  • Values inclusion, empowerment, and impact alongside analytical expertise.

  • Wants to shape how individuals and organisations use data to make better decisions.

Why join Corndel?

  • We're committed to having a fully inclusive, welcoming and safe culture and always striving to improve.

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

About Kalepa:

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

  • Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
  • Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
  • Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
  • Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
  • Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

OTE: $230K - $270K

jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants located in USA time zones (EST + CST only at this time).

Staff Software Engineer - Platform, Application Core Services

Application Core Services (AppCore) builds the control plane behind Grafana Cloud, designing the systems that create, configure, and operate thousands of customer environments safely and reliably.

Working at the intersection of product, platform, and operations, the team develops the services that power critical customer and internal workflows, from provisioning and cloud marketplace integrations to billing and customer lifecycle management. As Grafana Cloud continues to scale, we're solving complex distributed systems challenges around reliability, automation, and operational efficiency.

We're looking for engineers who enjoy building large-scale backend systems, improving developer experience, and leading technical initiatives that have a direct impact on both our customers and the engineers building on our platform.

As a remote-first, open source company, we value collaboration, ownership, and diverse perspectives, with opportunities to contribute across teams and to the broader OSS community.

What You’ll Be Doing:

You'll help build and operate the control plane behind Grafana Cloud. The team owns the systems responsible for creating, configuring, reconciling, migrating, and operating customer stacks at scale.

In this role you'll:

  • Design and build distributed backend systems that keep customer stack state consistent across Grafana Cloud.
  • Develop reconciliation and automation workflows that improve reliability, reduce operational complexity, and safely manage infrastructure changes.
  • Lead technical initiatives spanning multiple services and partner closely with Product, Infrastructure, Hosted Grafana, and adjacent platform teams.
  • Improve deployment workflows, regional expansion, rollout safety, and incident recovery across thousands of customer environments.
  • Own the production systems you build, including observability, operational tooling, on-call, and continuous reliability improvements.
  • As a remote-first team, we share ownership through a global follow-the-sun on-call rotation.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer who enjoys solving complex distributed systems problems and leading technical work from idea to production.

You'll likely be successful if you:

  • Have experience building and operating large-scale SaaS or cloud platforms.
  • Have strong backend engineering experience in Go or another systems language, and are comfortable learning new technologies.
  • Have experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Enjoy solving problems around distributed systems, eventual consistency, stateful services, and system reliability.
  • Can independently lead projects, navigate ambiguity, and influence technical direction across teams.
  • Care about writing clean, maintainable software and improving the developer experience.
  • Have experience participating in production operations, incident response, and on-call.
  • Are comfortable working in a remote-first, highly collaborative environment.

Bonus Points For:

We'd especially love to hear from you if you have experience with:

  • Kubernetes operators, reconcilers, or control plane development.
  • Go and TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Terraform, Flux, Argo, Jsonnet, Tanka, or similar infrastructure tooling.
  • SaaS provisioning, customer lifecycle systems, or multi-tenant platforms.
  • Solving problems related to configuration drift, partial failures, or cross-service consistency.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is USD 174,986- USD 209,983. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Kotlin - Especialista, para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas complexas, liderando de ponta a ponta o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção arquitetural ao deploy e operação em produção. Suas atividades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas complexas, atuando de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção arquitetural ao deploy e operação em produção.
  • Ser referência técnica para o time e para outras squads, garantindo padrões elevados de qualidade, performance, segurança e resiliência em serviços como BFFs, comm-hubs e APIs estratégicas.
  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas backend, avaliando trade-offs técnicos, riscos operacionais e impactos de longo prazo nas plataformas de AI Engineering.
  • Estabelecer e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia, incluindo TDD/BDD, clean code, DDD, code reviews estruturados e alta cobertura de testes automatizados.
  • Atuar fortemente na operação e sustentação dos sistemas em produção, com foco em observabilidade, análise de causa raiz, prevenção de incidentes e melhoria contínua.
  • Influenciar decisões técnicas junto a produto, dados, plataforma e arquitetura, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico de engenheiros do time, promovendo evolução de competências e maturidade em engenharia de software.

Perfil esperado:

  • Comunicação clara, com capacidade de traduzir questões técnicas para públicos diversos.
  • Forte senso de ownership técnico e mentalidade DevOps.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Postura de referência técnica, com disposição para apoiar o desenvolvimento de outros engenheiros.

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis

Requisitos e Experiência:

  • Experiência avançada e comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Kotlin ou Java, utilizando frameworks como Spring Boot em ambientes de alta escala.
  • Forte domínio em arquitetura de microsserviços e BFFs, incluindo versionamento de APIs, padrões de integração, resiliência, escalabilidade e comunicação assíncrona.
  • Experiência sólida com automação de testes em múltiplos níveis (unitários, integração, contrato), garantindo confiabilidade e segurança nas entregas.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como PostgreSQL, MongoDB e Cassandra, com foco em consistência, performance e disponibilidade.
  • Vivência robusta com sistemas de mensageria e streaming, como Kafka, SQS e SNS, em cenários de alta volumetria.
  • Domínio de práticas de observabilidade, incluindo métricas, logs estruturados, tracing distribuído e definição de SLIs/SLOs.
  • Experiência prática em ambientes Cloud (preferencialmente AWS), com uso de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou CloudFormation) e pipelines de CI/CD maduros.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança de aplicações, incluindo autenticação e autorização (JWT, OAuth2), criptografia e práticas de secure by design.
  • Atuação consistente em ambientes ágeis, com mentalidade DevOps, ownership técnico e foco em eficiência operacional.
  • Experiência prévia em plataformas complexas, integração entre sistemas ou produtos digitais de missão crítica.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em plataformas de AI Engineering ou integração de serviços de IA/LLMs ao backend.
  • Vivência em mentoria técnica formal ou programas de desenvolvimento de engenheiros.
  • Certificações em AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer ou similares).

jobs.description:
We're on the hunt for...

An Account Executive to join Athlon's Client Services team and become an important part of the operational backbone that helps us deliver brilliant work for our clients.

This is an entry-level role designed for someone who is highly organised, proactive and eager to build a career within account management.

You'll work across multiple clients, supporting account administration, client communication, internal reporting and agency-led initiatives.

You’ll collaborate with the client leads and internal studio team on live projects, pitches and new business and take ownership of administrative housekeeping. As you grow in confidence and experience, you'll take on increasing levels of responsibility, eventually leading your own projects and managing more complex client work.

With mentorship from the wider client service team, you will develop a strong understanding of Athlon's client management processes, build your commercial awareness, and deepen critical strategic thinking.

Your success will be measured by your organisational skills and attention to detail, your aptitude and willingness to learn, and your proactive approach to your work, your clients and your team.

Requirements


Responsibilities:

CLIENT RELATIONSHIP & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT

  • Support the internal team to deliver excellent client service
  • You respond promptly to requests and ensure all appropriate team members are consulted.
  • You provide clear communication and professional service at all times, always with a friendly and approachable attitude.
  • Meetings are organised efficiently with clear agendas, and contact reports are circulated promptly after meetings with clear actions, owners and deadlines.
  • You aid effective account management by ensuring projects are set-up correctly and all administration is completed in full and without having to be reminded.
  • You put yourself forward to support projects and share your own perspective and ideas in meetings. You proactively use your time and don’t wait for instruction.
  • You proactively keep up-to-date with industry news, providing insights on latest initiatives and emerging trends relevant to our clients and work.
  • You build strong relationships with the internal team, becoming recognised as someone who is dependable, organised and always willing to support.

PROJECT & COMMERCIAL OWNERSHIP

  • Ensure the team remains organised and set up for success.
  • You support admin across the entire client portfolio, taking full ownership of internal team reporting and keeping track of priorities and goals.
  • You own all new project set-up including setting up the project folder, Slack channel, and opening the project in Scoro, ensuring all necessary team members have access.
  • You join meetings to document discussions and to build your exposure to different projects and ways of working.
  • You support the client service team with crafting client facing documentation including research, proofing work and finalising proposals.
  • You support the client service team with onboarding new clients to Athlon.
  • You lead weekly internal client service meetings, keeping the status report updated and ensuring actions are followed up on time.

GROWTH

  • Support agency growth and develop your commercial understanding.
  • You build a good understanding of each client's business and Athlon’s relationship and projects-to-date, enabling you to input into the work and internal meetings.
  • You support the client service team with maintaining Client Intelligence Forms, carrying out research and ensuring information about the client's business is accurate and up-to-date.
  • You support the entire team with research, providing valuable insights to inform new projects and proposals.
  • You own Pipedrive and are responsible for keeping opportunities updated, supporting the entire team with adding their pipeline projects and using the weekly team meeting to review.
  • You keep track of all contract and retainer renewals, flagging to the team before they expire.
  • You own creation of case studies for key projects, seeking input from the team accordingly.
  • You support the Marketing team with securing client testimonials and case study approvals.
  • You help organise client reviews and feedback surveys, gifting, swag and events.
  • You begin recognising opportunities for additional work, regularly sharing observations and ideas with the team.

INTERNAL OPERATIONS

  • Support operational excellence and build your understanding of the agency process.
  • You take ownership of your administrative tasks, which are always completed accurately, in-depth, and on time without requiring reminders.
  • You share a weekly Monday update summarising your focuses and goals for the week ahead, along with any risks or support needs.
  • You help coordinate internal meetings, workshops and client sessions, ensuring agendas, attendees, meeting materials and follow-up actions are coordinated in full.
  • You own timely set- up and closing all projects in Scoro, ready for the project lead to use.
  • You own all CRM hygiene in PipeDrive and responsible for helping the team keep all client contact records up-to-date.
  • You own project retrospectives - cascading surveys, arranging client and team feedback sessions, and collating learnings.
  • You support the Client Service Director with client reporting, using PipeDrive data to track performance and trends, and ensuring weekly team tasks are completed on time.
  • You contribute ideas to improve client service processes, templates and ways of working, demonstrating initiative and a desire to support strong client partnership.

Five values that underpin everything we do

Be Brave: Take chances, be ambitious. This is how you grow. Take risks, nothing can substitute experience.

Take Ownership: Be a pro. Act like a champion. Own your domain. Not almost. All the way. Not most of the time. All of the time. Take ownership. Whatever it takes.

Team First: Talent wins games, but teamwork wins championships. Respect the team. Treat others fairly. Build friendships. Disagree honestly. Share ideas candidly. We’re one team first.

Craft Everything: Quality is never an accident; It’s always the result of intention, effort and skill. Craft everything.

Passion Over Apathy: One person with passion is better than forty people merely interested. Use your passion as a catalyst to motivate and lead others.

What we're looking for:

You may have recently finished education, training or an internship, and are looking for your first step into a career. There is no minimum experience required, however, experience managing projects or clients is a bonus. This role requires someone highly organised and enthusiastic, with a genuine desire to develop within the creative industry and agency environment.

You are:

  • Relationship-first: you are a natural people-person who enjoys building strong and collaborative relationships.
  • Attention to detail: you are thorough with high accuracy and always make sure to double check your work.
  • Curious: you ask questions, seek feedback and genuinely interested in how agencies create value for clients.
  • Proactive: you follow instructions but you also anticipate next steps, always trying to make things easier for your team.
  • Calm and dependable: you remain positive under pressure and not afraid to ask for support.
  • A strong communicator: you are clear, concise and professional at all times, but still friendly in your approach.
  • Team-first: you enjoy collaborating and contributing to a positive culture where everyone succeeds together.

We expect you to be familiar with:

  • Coordination and being organised
  • Comfortable contributing to client and team discussions, in-person and virtually
  • Creating documentation to a high standard, with close attention to detail and presentation
  • Experience managing person or professional projects
  • Basic software programmes such as Excel, Powerpoint and / or Keynote
  • Familiar with communication tools including Zoom, Teams and Slack
  • Comfortable working with different people and as part of a team

How we work:

  • Full-time role
  • Predominantly remote, with occasional in-person team and client meetings
  • Salary: commensurate with experience
  • You will report to the Client Service Director
  • You will support both the client service team and studio team accordingly

Benefits

jobs.description:
Job Title: Chief Operating Officer Location: Remote (in-office preferred - Meridian, ID) Reports to: Chief Executive Officer Direct Reports: VP of Underwriting, Operations Manager Employment Type: Full-Time Scope: Owns production operations end-to-end (origination, underwriting, fulfillment) and provides advisory input into servicing strategy. Servicing and secondary/capital markets operations are owned by their respective functions

Who We Are Retail-focused independent mortgage bank (IMB) originating $2B+ in annual volume, with a growing servicing portfolio (~$400M UPB) and an all-agency (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA) approval footprint. The organization runs lean and flat by design — this hire replaces layers of middle management with one senior operator who can own credit risk, run people, and fix throughput directly.

Role Summary This is a true COO-level mandate, distinct in scope and authority from a VP Operations role. The scope — credit risk ownership, direct agency relationships, systems/process strategy including AI implementation, and direct management of underwriting and operations leadership — calls for full executive-level authority and accountability. The COO will work closely with the CEO, executive team, and department heads to enhance operational efficiency, improve service quality, and drive growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own credit risk policy and credit box strategy — author, defend, and evolve the credit box as an active policy owner.
  • Manage the VP of Underwriting and Operations Manager — set performance targets, build a culture of accountability, and coach and develop both leaders directly.
  • Own agency relationships and escalations — serve as the direct point of contact with Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, and VA on overlays, QC findings, and repurchase demands.
  • Own systems and process strategy for origination, including the AI implementation roadmap — set the strategy and priorities, drawing on vendors or a systems hire for technical execution.
  • Advise on servicing strategy from the production side — provide strategic input on how credit box and product-mix decisions affect MSR value and retention, keeping production operations as the core focus.
  • Retain hands-on fallback capability — step in personally to work a stuck file or a broken workflow when direct reports need support, reflecting a hands-on leadership style.

Required Qualifications - Priority Order

  • Deep credit risk expertise (highest priority)
  • Has personally authored and defended credit box and credit policy design as a true policy owner, taking ownership of authorship rather than enforcement alone.
  • Has personally negotiated with agencies on overlay treatment, QC escalations, or repurchase demands, leading these conversations directly rather than delegating them.
  • Understands how credit decisions flow through to servicing and MSR performance.
  • Strong people management
  • Has directly managed underwriting and operations leaders in a flat, accountability-heavy culture, maintaining a direct span of control rather than managing through layers of middle management.
  • Sets clear targets, holds people to them, and coaches and develops direct reports.
  • Steps in personally to work a file or a process when needed, balancing hands-on involvement with team autonomy so the team keeps moving rather than becoming dependent.
  • Deep agency knowledge
  • Fluent in Fannie Mae DU, Freddie Mac LPA overlays, FHA TOTAL Scorecard, and VA automated underwriting.
  • Understands how overlays get built into underwriting policy through direct, practical application, going beyond theoretical or classroom knowledge.
  • Retail fulfillment and throughput background
  • Has personally owned pull-through rate, cycle time, and underwriter capacity planning as direct, individual KPIs, with hands-on accountability rather than secondhand oversight.
  • Built this experience at a $1.5B–$5B retail-focused IMB, in an environment distinct from depository banking or correspondent-heavy lending models.
  • Compliance and audit experience
  • Experience serving as a key point of contact through Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac audits, from information requests through findings and remediation.
  • Experience with Ginnie Mae oversight and audits, including the reporting and compliance expectations tied to Ginnie Mae issuer status.
  • Extensive experience with compliance oversight more broadly, with a track record of building and maintaining a strong compliance posture across origination operations.

Preferred Qualifications (Additive Strengths)

  • AI/automation implementation experience in origination — a strong plus, and equally well covered through a systems hire or vendor partnership.
  • Direct servicing operations experience — a valuable complement to the advisory and strategic input this role provides on servicing, though the core requirements stand on their own.
  • Working knowledge of employment law and/or contract law — useful for navigating people-management decisions, vendor and agency agreements, and other contractual matters that intersect with this role.
  • Familiarity with ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) structures — helpful given the potential for equity or profit-interest arrangements tied to this role and the broader organization.
  • CFPB audit experience — a strong plus given the regulatory scrutiny facing IMBs, and complementary to the agency and compliance audit experience above.
  • Broad product knowledge acumen — depth across conventional, government, and non-QM product types strengthens credit box strategy and supports informed conversations on product mix.

PMR Core Values No matter your position or department, your primary responsibility at PMR is to embody our core values — Vision, Hustle, Grit, and Execute — in everything you do.

  • Vision – Innovate / Cultivate: Leads with foresight and creativity, fostering innovation in loan programs, production processes, and team development. Encourages collaboration and continuous improvement that shapes PMR's future.
  • Hustle – Speed / Excel: Embraces a sense of urgency and a results-driven mindset. Drives the team to move quickly, seize opportunities, and deliver outstanding service to clients and partners.
  • Grit – Strength / Courage: Perseveres through challenges with resilience and determination. Leads with courage during change and sets the tone for consistent, principled performance.
  • Execute – Implement / Achieve: Translates strategic goals into tangible outcomes. Holds the team accountable for precision, timeliness, and excellence in every stage of production.
