jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.excerpt: The roleWe’re looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help evolve how Solflare shows up across campaigns, social media, presentations, events, merchandise, and other physical and digital experiences.
jobs.description:
The role

We’re looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help evolve how Solflare shows up across campaigns, social media, presentations, events, merchandise, and other physical and digital experiences.

This is a senior, hands on individual contributor role for someone who can turn a brief into a strong creative concept and scalable visual system and execute it to a high standard. Experience with motion is valuable, but deep motion specialization is not required.

You’ll own briefs from concept through delivery and execute most of the work yourself. You’ll also brief and direct freelancers or specialist partners when a project requires additional capacity or expertise.

You’ll report to the Head of Design and work within the Brand & Creative team, partnering closely with Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Design, and Operations. You’ll present your work, actively seek feedback, and contribute a clear point of view to the work of the wider team.

This is not a people management role, a full time art direction position, or a rebrand. Solflare already has a strong identity. Your job will be to extend it intelligently, creating new expressions and systems without losing what makes the brand recognizable. Over time, the role can grow toward greater art direction responsibility while remaining close to the craft.

Core responsibilities:

Campaigns and brand expression

  • Turn product launches, company initiatives, and marketing briefs into memorable visual concepts and campaign systems.
  • Design creative for web, social media, paid campaigns, app-store assets, presentations, and other marketing channels.
  • Partner with Marketing and Product Marketing to continuously raise the standard of Solflare’s campaigns and social presence.
  • Extend the Solflare identity when new formats or challenges require solutions beyond the existing guidelines.

Digital and motion

  • Translate brand concepts into effective digital and social content.
  • Use motion where it strengthens an idea, either by creating straightforward animations yourself or collaborating with motion specialists.
  • Brief and direct external motion designers when a project requires specialist expertise.
  • Ensure motion work feels consistent with Solflare’s broader brand identity.

Systems and creative quality

  • Build reusable templates, libraries, components, and guidelines that help the team produce high quality work efficiently.
  • Review creative across channels and identify opportunities for stronger consistency, clearer storytelling, and more effective production workflows.
  • Brief and collaborate with freelancers, illustrators, motion designers, and production partners when specialist support is needed.

Events and physical experiences

  • Develop creative concepts for conferences, sponsorships, events, and merchandise that help Solflare stand out online and in person.
  • Design high impact company presentations, internal communications, recruitment campaigns, and employer-brand materials.
  • Prepare production ready artwork, review proofs, and work with vendors to ensure high-quality physical execution.

Requirements:

  • At least five years of experience in brand, visual, or graphic design, supported by a portfolio that demonstrates both depth and range.
  • Exceptional craft in typography, composition, hierarchy, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience working within an established identity system and meaningfully extending it not only applying existing templates.
  • Experience applying brand systems across several formats, such as campaigns, digital content, presentations, print, merchandise, or events. We don’t expect you to be a specialist in every area.
  • The ability to take ownership from brief through delivery, challenge unclear or weak briefs constructively, and make thoughtful creative decisions.
  • A collaborative, low ego approach and the ability to give and receive direct feedback.
  • Thoughtful use of generative AI and modern creative tools, with good judgment about where they increase speed and where hands-on craft matters more.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Your portfolio

A portfolio is required. Applications without one cannot be considered.

Please send links rather than attachments and include three to five projects that demonstrate:

  • Exceptional brand and visual-design craft.
  • Experience developing a concept into a coherent campaign or visual system.
  • An identity system you meaningfully extended beyond its original guidelines.
  • Range across relevant digital and physical formats.
  • Your specific role, the constraints you worked within, and the reasoning behind your key decisions.

Motion work is welcome. A small number of well explained projects is more valuable than a large collection of disconnected visuals.

Nice to have

  • Experience creating short form motion for brand or campaign work.
  • Experience briefing or directing motion designers.
  • Experience with After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similar tools.
  • Experience with 3D tools.
  • Illustration skills that broaden your creative range.
  • Experience working with crypto, fintech, or highly technical products.
  • An interest in Web3, digital ownership, or emerging technologies.

Personality traits we value:

  • Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
  • Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride, no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
  • Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
  • Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
  • Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
  • Flexibility: Remote or office - up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time - work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement
  • Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few
  • Learn about crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.

About us

Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 4 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 150 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets - achieving true financial independence.

Our culture

At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive - starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth - yours, ours, and society’s - you’ll feel right at home.

jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Cost Estimator to join our team supporting our federal client in the delivery of high visibility infrastructural projects central to a federal government Design-Build programs. In this role you will provide cost estimating expertise to support the client’s expanding nationwide construction program.

High preference is to get a candidate located in the Huntsville , AL area however if not the positions can be Remote with 50% travel.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analyze designs, drawings, proposals, scopes of work, and/or specifications to determine cost projections, and develop comprehension budget cost estimates for complex buildings, MEP systems and infrastructure for a variety of facility types
  • Assist in the development and preparation of detailed work breakdown structures (WBS) and construction logic for contracts, projects and elements of programs to support the development of estimate development and delivery.

jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our team.

Position Description

In this role, you will own the design, development, integration, and validation of electrical systems supporting a nuclear fuel recycling facility. These systems include facility power distribution, electrical infrastructure, equipment power systems, and interfaces with process and control systems.

This is a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) facility, and this role requires ownership across the full lifecycle from early concept development through detailed design, construction, commissioning, and operations.

This role includes close collaboration with cross-functional teams focused on facility design, process engineering, controls engineering, equipment design, and licensing.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Lead the design and implementation of facility electrical systems from concept through commissioning

  • Design and specify high-, medium-, and low-voltage power distribution systems

  • Define system architecture, including redundancy, backup power, and safety strategies

  • Perform and review power system studies (load flow, short-circuit, coordination)

  • Generate and review electrical documentation (single-line diagrams, load lists, specifications, cable schedules)

  • Lead integration with control systems (PLC/DCS/HMI)

  • Develop grounding, bonding, and lightning protection strategies

  • Support procurement, installation, and commissioning activities

  • Collaborate on facility layout, constructability, and maintainability

  • Generate technical documentation supporting regulatory and licensing efforts

  • Serve as the electrical technical lead across lifecycle stages

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

  • 10+ years of experience designing and deploying industrial or facility-scale electrical systems

  • Demonstrated ownership of electrical system design through multiple project phases (concept through commissioning)

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience in nuclear, fuel cycle, or similarly regulated industrial environments

  • Deep experience in power systems design (switchgear, transformers, protection systems)

  • Expertise in power system analysis (load flow, short circuit, coordination studies)

  • Experience integrating electrical and controls systems (PLC/DCS/HMI)

  • Commissioning and startup experience in complex facilities

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer that is:

  • Able to take ownership and drive work across ambiguous, early stage environments

  • Thinking at the system level, not just the component level

  • Passionate about clean energy

  • An optimist at heart

  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality

  • Motivated by building, and getting technology deployed

  • Willing and able to learn quickly

  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before

  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems

  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!

  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $130,000-$200,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, competitive pay, 401k, health insurance, FSA, flexible work hours, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Location: Our Solutions Engineer, DoiT Cloud Intelligence, will be an integral part of our Solutions Engineering / Field Engineering team in APAC. Who We AreDoiT is a global technology company empowering cloud-driven organizations to achieve business growth and innovation through strategic cloud utilization. We blend data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state, from initial planning to full-scale production.
With extensive experience across various cloud environments, we possess deep specializations in Cloud Data Platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, as well as FinOps expertise. As a trusted and award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we proudly support over 4,000 customers worldwide.
Our flagship offering is DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI), which uniquely combines advanced technology with human insight, enabling us to solve complex multicloud challenges and drive significant efficiency for our clients.

The DoiT Cloud Intelligence platform:

  • Provides deep visibility into cloud cost, usage, performance, and optimization opportunities across complex multi-cloud environments, enabling organizations to make data-driven infrastructure decisions.
  • Combines automation, analytics, and expert guidance to identify savings opportunities, improve resource efficiency, and continuously optimize cloud investments at scale.
  • Powers Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Systems Integrators (SIs), and Private Equity (PE) operating teams with portfolio-level insights, benchmarking, and operational tooling to manage multiple cloud environments effectively.
  • Goes beyond reporting by delivering prescriptive recommendations and automated workflows that help engineering, finance, and platform teams turn cloud intelligence into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

The Opportunity

As a Solutions Engineer supporting DoiT Cloud Intelligence in Thailand, you will be the hands-on technical face of DoiT in the local market. Partnering with Account Executives, Customer Success, and the AWS field team, you will help Thai enterprises, digital natives, MSPs, and Systems Integrators unlock actionable insights across their AWS and multi-cloud environments — driving cost efficiency, operational visibility, and smarter cloud decision-making through DCI.
This is a growth-oriented Field Engineering role. You are chartered to drive DCI and product adoption through high-impact technical sales plays, measurable revenue growth, partner-led pipeline, new logo acquisition, and upsell/cross-sell motions. You will sit at the intersection of customers, cloud platforms, and our product — an embedded technical partner inside the account team rather than a reactive support resource.

Responsibilities

Technical Qualification & Discovery: Collaborate with the Account Executive to thoroughly understand the prospect’s cloud environment, FinOps maturity, cost management challenges, and operational goals through in-depth technical discovery sessions across engineering, finance, and platform teams.
Technical Validation & POV Leadership: Own and drive technical validation and Proof of Value (POV) exercises for DoiT Cloud Intelligence, including POV preparation, proactive management, and ensuring successful technical outcomes that demonstrate clear value and alignment with prospect requirements.
Platform Demonstrations: Develop and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of DCI in Thai and English, showcasing cloud cost visibility, optimization insights, and operational intelligence across complex multi-cloud environments.
Business Case & ROI Development: Leverage your understanding of cloud economics and FinOps to build business cases and ROI analyses that clearly articulate the financial and operational impact of adopting DCI, for both engineering and executive audiences.
AWS Partner-Led Growth: Work with AWS field teams and local partners on co-sell motions, partner-sourced pipeline, and accelerator programs — including GenAI, Migration Acceleration Program (MAP), and Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR) engagements. Support GTM initiatives that convert partner relationships into qualified opportunities.
Hands-On Cloud Engineering: Act as a trusted cloud engineer who designs and helps implement improvements in cost efficiency, resilience, security posture, and operational automation. Lead structured technical engagements such as optimization sessions, reliability and security reviews, architecture deep dives, migration assessments, and Well-Architected style assessments.
DCI Power User & Expertise: Become the go-to expert for DoiT Cloud Intelligence in the region: build analytics and cost allocation views, surface cost and risk opportunities, write Composer queries, create CloudFlow automations, and embed DCI into customer observability, governance, and CI/CD workflows.
Partner & Portfolio Motion Support (MSP, PE, SI): Support technical engagements with MSPs, PE firms, and SIs by demonstrating how DCI enables portfolio-level visibility, operational insight across multiple cloud environments, and scalable optimization strategies.
Technical Win Ownership: Take full ownership of the technical win for DCI engagements — guiding prospects through evaluation, addressing technical requirements, and building confidence in the platform’s ability to drive cloud efficiency and operational insight.
Reusable Assets & Enablement. Convert field work into reusable assets: playbooks, Terraform modules, automations, architecture diagrams, internal tooling, and documented patterns. Create external-facing technical content such as webinars, workshops, and customer enablement sessions in Thai.
Event & Conference Presentations. Represent DoiT and DCI at local and regional events, AWS events, webinars, and industry conferences, delivering engaging presentations and demonstrations.
Product Feedback & Customer Advocacy. Translate customer pain points, partner requirements, and feature gaps into structured, technically credible input for Product and Engineering, helping shape the evolution of the Cloud Intelligence platform. Represent the voice of the Thai and APAC technical customer in roadmap discussions.
Accurate, Timely Documentation. Ensure timely entry of data into internal business support systems and contribute to the tools and metrics that highlight business performance and effectiveness.

About You

You are an accomplished Solutions Engineer or hands-on cloud architect with customer-facing experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS or cloud consulting environment. You are a native Thai speaker who can move fluidly between a Thai-language executive conversation and an English-language technical deep dive with a global product team.
You are excited about enabling companies to transform themselves using the public cloud, and you hold yourself accountable for the success of any initiative you are involved in. You want to be part of a high-performance, growth-focused organization and you enjoy winning against the competition. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, entrepreneurial, remote-first environment across multiple time zones.

Qualifications

Native-level Thai fluency (spoken and written) with professional working proficiency in English.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating production workloads on AWS (experience with GCP or Azure is a strong plus), with the ability to reason across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and observability.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role — Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales Engineering, or Field/Forward Deployed Engineering — selling or delivering into enterprise and mid-market accounts.
  • Depth in at least one technical domain: cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, or ML/GenAI.
  • Practical FinOps and cloud cost management judgment: the ability to explain cost-versus-performance-versus-reliability tradeoffs to both engineers and finance/leadership stakeholders.
  • Practical observability experience: monitoring, logging, and alerting, and an understanding of tools in the ecosystem such as Datadog, New Relic, ServiceNow, and cloud-native equivalents.
  • An automation mindset with coding or scripting ability, plus hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD tooling.
  • Strong data analysis skills and comfort navigating large data sets and spreadsheets to identify trends, outliers, correlations, and reconciliation needs.
  • The ability to take complex pieces of technology and explain them in a simple, easy-to-understand way.
  • Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive-level prospects and customers.
  • Comfort working in a metric-driven environment, reporting on and improving business performance against monthly KPIs.
  • Experience working in an account-team model across multiple functions (AE, CSM, AM, TAM) and time zones.
  • Intellectual curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Bonus Points

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking, Machine Learning) or FinOps Certified Practitioner.
  • Prior experience working with or alongside AWS partner programs (MAP, WAFR, GenAI accelerators) or within an AWS Partner / MSP / SI.
  • Background in FinOps, SRE, or platform engineering.
  • Experience with cloud cost management or cloud intelligence platforms such as DCI.
  • Datacenter and hypervisor experience (e.g. VMware) in the context of migration to cloud.
  • Experience with modern technical selling best practices, including trial, demo, POV, and RFP processes.
  • Contributions to open source, public speaking, community leadership, or internal enablement.
  • Track record of success in a fast-growing and scaling business.

Are you a Do’er?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ’apply’ button.

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options

  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it’s our strength. In this role, you’ll build and optimize multi-channel programs across email, SMS, and in-app experiences using tools like Customer.io and HubSpot, leveraging data, segmentation, and automation to drive meaningful connections. As a key partner across Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Clinical teams, you’ll help shape seamless, patient-first experiences that align with business goals, including engagement and outcomes. You’ll also act as a champion for innovation: using AI and emerging tools to scale impact, while ensuring all communications meet HIPAA standards and healthcare marketing best practices.

This includes running all email and SMS campaigns, owning the build calendar, sequencing, establishing cadence, A/B testing, tracking performance across both channels, and mapping in customer details, preferences, and contract considerations.

Requirements

  • Strong analytical and technical skills, with the ability to interpret customer behavior and campaign performance to inform marketing strategy.

You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.

  • 10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years leading development teams of 8–20 engineers.

  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform—Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, REST/Platform Events, and Node.js↔Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Proven technical architect background: designed distributed systems, API contracts, data models, and performance-critical solutions in production.
  • Track record of schedule compression—case studies where you measurably reduced cycle time or pulled in release dates without sacrificing quality.

  • Ship the current roadmap on a compressed timeline agreed with leadership.
  • Improve estimate accuracy (commit vs. deliver) to within an agreed tolerance.
  • Meet or exceed performance SLOs for the Node.js + Salesforce solution stack.
  • Retain and level-up the existing team while filling any skill gaps.

Why Flosum

At Flosum, we believe great software is built by great teams—and great teams are built by leaders who care deeply about both the craft and the people. You will have the autonomy, the talent, and the mandate to build something exceptional. If you want to lead a team that is setting the standard for what world-class software looks like, we want to talk to you.

Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.
The Controls Group Support Engineer provides technical support for the deployment, testing, and operation of data center control and monitoring systems. Working under the direction of senior controls engineers and the Manager Controls, this role supports construction, commissioning, and operational phases by assisting with system validation, troubleshooting, documentation, and vendor coordination. The position focuses on ensuring controls systems perform as designed and meet quality expectations through Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO) and turnover processes from Operations Engineering into steady-state operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the deployment of data center control and monitoring systems during construction and commissioning (L1-L5) activities under the guidance of senior controls personnel.
  • Assist with validation and documentation of controls and monitoring systems, performance, ensuring deliverables are complete, accurate, and suitable for handover to Operations.
  • Provide technical support related to building operations, mechanical and electrical plant controls, BMS/EPMS systems, and associated field devices.
  • Execute point-to-point verification, software logic checks, and graphics testing to confirm operability, compatibility, and alignment with design intent.
  • In coordination with Operations Engineering, review QA/QC activities, hardware installations, control panels, wiring, and programming changes identified during commissioning.
  • Participate in commissioning testing to validate controls settings, alarm thresholds, system integrations, and basic operability of infrastructure systems.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of controls-related operational issues, including Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), and other events impacting operations, in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Collaborate with Operations, Development, Operations Engineering, and vendor teams to identify defects, document findings, and support corrective actions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying recurring issues, documenting lessons learned, and suggesting enhancements to controls systems or procedures.
  • In coordination with Operations Engineering, maintain accurate and timely documentation, including test results, commissioning records, as-built updates, and operational reference materials.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline; equivalent industry or military experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience supporting controls engineering activities, including system installation, testing, start-up, commissioning, or operations in industrial or critical environments.
  • Exposure to control system integration involving multiple vendors, subsystems, and field devices.
  • Working knowledge of control theory fundamentals, including proportional-integral-derivative (PID) concepts.
  • Familiarity with PLC or SCADA-based control systems and standard industrial programming environments.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering documentation, including electrical one-line diagrams, control diagrams, network schematics, and control panel drawings.
  • Experience supporting data centers or other mission-critical facilities such as hospitals, laboratories, defense facilities, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or oil and gas operations
  • Hands-on experience with electrical or mechanical controls systems installation, service, or field support.
  • Familiarity with commissioning processes, test procedures, and basic safety and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience working with BMS, EPMS, or industrial automation platforms in an operational support capacity.
  • Ability to produce clear, consistent technical documentation, test reports, and operational reference materials.
  • General knowledge of critical data center equipment, including generators, UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, chillers, air handling units (AHU, CRAH, CRAC), fire detection and suppression systems, and associated controls.
The listed salary range for this position is an estimate based on the competitive job market. Final compensation will be based on your own individual skills, experience, and location.

jobs.description:
College Board - BigFuture

Location: This is a remote role, aligned to core EST hours. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

BigFuture reaches over 7 million students each year and is the leading free online resource for College, Scholarship, and Career Exploration. Our BigFuture product team is committed to helping every student own their future. BigFuture consists of three integrated product offerings that serve both students and higher education institutions:

  • BigFuture.org provides students and families with tools to explore colleges, discover scholarships, understand how to pay for college, and learn about career pathways. It empowers all students to unlock opportunities that match their aspirations and financial needs.

  • BigFuture School is a privacy-forward mobile app that supports students and educators at participating K-12 schools in making critical connections between students’ unique strengths and interests and future pathway opportunities. Students can connect with over 1,500 higher education institutions and receive messages tailored to their interests and goals—putting them in the driver’s seat of their journey.

  • College Enrollment Solutions enable higher education institutions to authentically engage in student relevant recruitment efforts to advance college access. Through tools like Search and Connections, colleges can discover and reach a broad population of students from more than 25,000 high schools nationwide.

Our team collaborates deeply with other cross-functional teams including Community, Technology, Research, College Readiness Assessments, Strategic Higher Education, State & District Partnerships, Legal, and Finance.

About the Opportunity

As the Product Manager, Career Exploration for BigFuture School, you bring a strategic, self-directing approach and thrive in ambiguity, with a passion for solving complex problems and driving meaningful outcomes. You will play a central role in one of College Board’s highest priority initiatives, connecting learning to opportunity by helping students understand the skills they are developing, how those skills align to their interests, and how to plan for life after high school. This is highly visible, mission-critical work, and you will serve as a critical influencer and collaborator across the organization, partnering closely with programs including College Readiness Assessments, Advanced Placement, and Learning and Assessment to ensure BigFuture serves as a meaningful through line that changes the way students think about relevance in high school and how it translates to their future.

You leverage your strong background in product management and educational technology to maintain a strategic roadmap for BigFuture based on market trends, customer needs, and organizational priorities. You are eager to solicit and analyze feedback from a diverse set of stakeholders, including higher ed enrollment leaders, state and district partners, schools, students, and internal College Board teams, turning insights into impactful actions. You collaborate closely with cross-functional scrum teams, lead execution efforts with excellence, and build strong relationships that produce tremendous value for students and the organization. In the face of complexity, you lean in with initiative, demonstrating the leadership and influence needed to deliver results that matter.

In this role, you will:

Planning & Roadmap Development (50%)

  • Assist with crafting compelling strategy briefs, business cases, and product roadmaps to justify product investments aligned with BigFuture’s divisional goals

  • Lead the full product development lifecycle - from ideation and new feature development to enhancements and responsible sunsetting of legacy functionality

  • Identify and validate user problems and opportunities through data, user research, and analytics; ensure customer and business needs are integrated into the development process

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to refine the product roadmap in response to changing customer needs, market trends, and internal priorities

  • Clearly communicate product strategy and roadmap across cross-functional teams to maintain alignment and support decision-making

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop launch strategies, training materials, documentation, and engagement content

  • Maintain deep industry and market knowledge while serving as a subject matter expert on BigFuture’s platform, vision, and strategy internally and externally

Execution & Delivery (50%)

  • Break down features into user stories with clear acceptance criteria, developed collaboratively with technology, UX, and other stakeholders—while maintaining ownership as the Product Manager

  • Partner with technology managers to understand technical constraints and drive product needs through a technical lens

  • Maintain a well-groomed backlog of user-centered stories, prioritizing work based on the product roadmap, technical considerations, and strategic objectives

  • Drive delivery through active participation in Agile ceremonies - refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives - fostering continuous improvement and team alignment

  • Monitor initiatives closely to identify risks, resolve blockers, and ensure timely delivery of product milestones.

  • Coordinate complex technical, legal, and data-related dependencies across multiple teams to support seamless product development execution

  • Continuously assess product performance through data and user feedback, ensuring outcomes align with defined goals and drive value

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with substantial expertise in education technology, including work across the K-12 and/or Higher Ed sectors

  • Experience in career exploration, workforce development, career readiness, or a related domain is strongly preferred; candidates without this background bring genuine curiosity and the humility to build domain knowledge quickly

  • A proactive, ownership-first mindset; you don’t just relay messages, you take initiative, solve problems, and drive outcomes with purpose and accountability

  • Hands-on experience working in an Agile product development environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams

  • A customer-centric approach combined with strong organizational awareness; you’re curious and adaptable with tremendous learning agility

  • Strong analytical skills, combining quantitative data and qualitative insights with creative thinking to define problems and craft innovative, effective solutions

  • A proven track record of building trusted, productive relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences

  • Experience working with AI in a production environment, with a strong curiosity to learn more

  • Mobile app experience is a plus

  • The ability to travel 5-7 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000 - $157,000.

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront—rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Financial Analyst / Data Analyst – Remote

SQL | Financial Modeling | Business Intelligence | FP&A

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Financial Analyst / Data Analyst to transform financial and operational data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of finance, analytics, and business strategy, combining financial modeling, forecasting, SQL-based data analysis, and business intelligence reporting. You’ll build dashboards, analyze trends, develop financial models, and provide leadership with accurate, data-driven recommendations that influence company performance.

If you’re passionate about turning complex data into meaningful insights and enjoy working with both financial analysis and business intelligence, this is an excellent opportunity to make a measurable impact.

What You’ll Own

Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Build and maintain three-statement financial models (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow).
  • Develop forecasts, budgets, and rolling financial projections.
  • Perform scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, and forecasting.
  • Analyze ROI, IRR, break-even points, and investment performance.
  • Support strategic business decisions through financial analysis and modeling.

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Query, extract, and analyze data using SQL.
  • Clean, structure, and transform datasets using Excel, Python, R, or similar tools.
  • Conduct variance analysis comparing actual results against forecasts and budgets.
  • Identify business trends, operational risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear business recommendations.

Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Design and maintain dashboards using:
    • Tableau
    • Power BI
    • Looker
  • Prepare monthly financial reports, executive summaries, and board-level presentations.
  • Ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and easy to understand.
  • Automate recurring reporting where possible.

Forecasting & FP&A Support

  • Support budgeting and financial planning processes.
  • Maintain rolling forecasts using real-time business performance.
  • Improve forecasting accuracy through continuous analysis.
  • Assist leadership with strategic planning and financial decision-making.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Validate financial and operational data across multiple systems.
  • Maintain documentation for models, assumptions, and reporting methodologies.
  • Ensure reporting integrity and consistency.
  • Improve data governance and reporting standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Sales, and Leadership teams.
  • Present findings and recommendations in clear business language.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives with structured financial analysis.
  • Help leadership make informed, data-driven decisions.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Financial Analysis
    • FP&A
    • Data Analytics
  • Experience supporting business decision-making through financial and operational analysis.

Core Skills

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • INDEX/MATCH
    • Financial Modeling
    • Advanced formulas
  • Strong SQL skills, including:
    • Data extraction
    • Joins
    • Query optimization
  • Experience with financial reporting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Technical Stack

  • SQL
  • Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets
  • Tableau
  • Power BI
  • Looker

Nice to Have

  • Python or R for data analysis.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as:
    • NetSuite
    • SAP
    • Oracle
  • Experience supporting SaaS, Finance, Healthcare, or similar industries.
  • Experience building executive dashboards and automated reporting.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Able to simplify complex financial and operational data.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets and ambiguity.
  • Strong business acumen with a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communicator who presents insights clearly.
  • Proactive and continuously identifies opportunities for improvement.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Extract and clean financial and operational data using SQL.
  • Update financial models with current business performance.
  • Perform variance and scenario analysis.
  • Build and refine dashboards for leadership.
  • Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Improve reporting processes and forecasting accuracy.

In short: You transform financial and operational data into reliable insights that help leadership make smarter, faster business decisions.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Forecast accuracy within target ranges (±5–10%)
  • Timely delivery of financial and operational reports
  • Dashboard reliability and stakeholder adoption
  • Data accuracy and reporting consistency
  • Quality of financial insights supporting business decisions
  • Leadership satisfaction with reporting and analysis

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High visibility with leadership and decision-makers.
  • Opportunity to influence business strategy through data.
  • Strong blend of finance, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Exposure to forecasting, financial planning, and executive reporting.
  • Fully remote work environment with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Clear career progression into:
    • Senior Financial Analyst
    • FP&A Manager
    • Business Intelligence Manager
    • Finance Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Financial Model or Dashboard Exercise)
  4. Final Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Everything we do is for educators. We’re partnering with them to advance a bold vision for education that boosts district performance and student success. At Follett Software, we empower educators across roles with technology that streamlines processes and manages information and resources to improve their schools, increase student success, and drive the future of education. We believe that by empowering educators to amplify their impact on students’ lives, we can change the world. Our goal and mission is to drive the future of education. We are inspired by educators to deliver transformative technology. Our innovative, connected solutions simplify challenges and offer a seamless and intuitive experience.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Director, Software Development is responsible for leading the engineering organization for Follett Software’s library portfolio, including K–12 library products, international library management solutions, and shared platform capabilities that support the portfolio. This role brings together engineering leadership across multiple library products and shared platform capabilities – serving K-12 school libraries and international library management – with accountability for delivery, modernization, and operational performance across the portfolio.

The Senior Director provides strategic and operational leadership across the full software development lifecycle, including planning, architecture, development, testing, release, maintenance, and continuous improvement. They will lead development managers and engineers responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and reliable software that serves educators, librarians, administrators, and school districts across domestic and international markets.

This leader partners closely with Product, Design, QA, Cloud Engineering, Technical Support, and customer-facing teams to translate business priorities into engineering execution. They drive technical strategy and architectural modernization while balancing product innovation, platform stability, customer commitments, and operational excellence across all the library suite.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic and collaborative senior engineering leader who combines strong people leadership with sound technical judgment, cross-product organizational experience, and a clear focus on customer outcomes.

POSITION SCOPE

Engineering Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead the engineering organizations for domestic and international Library Management products and the wider Destiny platform, ensuring strong delivery, team health, and operational continuity across all product lines.
  • Establish and execute an engineering vision aligned to product strategy, customer needs, and company goals, while owning delivery of the roadmap across Library Management and the shared Destiny platform from planning through release and follow-through.
  • Provide technical and organizational leadership across architecture, modernization, engineering standards, and operational excellence, with attention to scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Ensure leadership continuity through critical business periods, especially the back-to-school season, including release cadence, escalation ownership, cross-team coordination, and customer-impacting issue management across all products.

Cross-Product and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Security, QA, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Technical Support, and other customer-facing teams to improve product outcomes, resolve escalations, and strengthen end-to-end execution.
  • Operate effectively across distinct product contexts—including Destiny Library Manager/Resource Manager and Accessit Library—while identifying opportunities to strengthen shared platform capabilities and connected experiences across the broader library ecosystem. Represent engineering priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery status clearly and credibly to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.

Organizational Leadership and Talent

  • Lead organizational design, talent planning, hiring, coaching, and succession across all three product lines, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and grow development managers and senior engineers, providing regular coaching, clear performance expectations, and meaningful career development opportunities.
  • Identify and nurture individual strengths and specialized abilities to drive career development and team satisfaction.
  • Partner with recruiting to attract top engineering talent and build retention strategies that recognize achievement and create advancement pathways.
  • Create and maintain a positive, inclusive, secure and collaborative engineering culture that promotes open communication and a sense of belonging.

Operational Excellence and Governance

  • Maintain strong operating rigor and organizational clarity through durable documentation, clear ownership, and effective communication of key product, team, customer, vendor, and operational context.
  • Use metrics, judgment, and business context to manage priorities, resources, budgets, risks, and team performance, and to drive sound engineering decisions.
  • Ensure regular, transparent communication with teams about organizational updates, changes, and expectations, facilitating open dialogue and encouraging feedback.

Modern Engineering Practices and AI Adoption

  • Champion adoption of modern engineering practices, including AI-enabled and Spec-Driven Development approaches, by building clarity, accountability, and strong technical leadership across the organization.
  • Advance engineering maturity across the portfolio through modern development practices, appropriate use of AI-enabled workflows, and clear technical and delivery standards.Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of software development leadership experience, including significant experience in senior engineering leadership roles with responsibility for multiple teams and/or product lines.
  • Proven success leading large or multi-product engineering functions, including direct reports who are themselves people leaders.
  • Strong experience delivering and supporting commercial software products in a SaaS, web application, or hybrid software environment.
  • Strong technical foundation in modern software engineering practices and sufficient depth to credibly guide teams working across diverse technology stacks, including Java, J2EE, .Net and service integrations, SQL Server, JavaScript, Git-based workflows, and Jira or similar development tools.
  • Experience leading modernization efforts in environments that include legacy technologies such as Java, J2EE, .Net, JBoss, WildFly, SQL, jQuery, or third-party UI frameworks, while moving teams toward more scalable and maintainable approaches.
  • Familiarity with Azure or comparable cloud platforms, CI/CD practices, automated testing, release management, and secure software development principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution in a fast-paced, multi-product environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence across functions, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and lead through change.
  • Experience setting direction through metrics, managing budgets and resources, and making data-informed decisions.
  • Strong judgment, emotional intelligence, and a track record of building healthy, accountable, high-performing teams.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with AI development techniques, coding agents, Spec-Driven Development, and AI-embedded CLI/IDE tooling.
  • Experience in EdTech, K-12 software, library systems, resource management, or other education-adjacent software environments.
  • Experience leading engineering across international or multi-market product lines, including awareness of regional compliance, data residency, or localization considerations.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing products with complex implementation, integration, and support considerations.
  • Experience leading teams through seasonal or customer-critical operating periods with high continuity requirements.
  • Experience driving adoption of modern engineering practices such as AI-enabled development, spec-driven workflows, or similar operating models.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • This role is remote and only open to candidates currently located in the United States and able to work without sponsorship.

  • Work hours and schedules may be adjusted as needed to meet the requirements of the position, the needs of the organization, and collaboration with teams operating outside of the U.S., including overlap with their working hours when necessary.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Perform tasks in a home office environment with frequent virtual meetings, communications, and interruptions, requiring effective time management and prioritization.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Position

Global Energy Monitor is seeking an experienced communications professional to join its communications team. The Strategic Communications Manager will be responsible for GEM’s editorial calendar and support communications work across its editorial portfolio and media relations – identifying key trends and stories within complex data and translating them into compelling narratives.

This is a broad, hands-on role for someone with strategic judgement and disciplined project management skills and the ability to lend a hand across a diverse communications portfolio. The manager will work closely with GEM’s Communications and program teams to support major reports, data releases, and other communications projects from initial planning through publication and follow-up.

The Challenge

According to the Intergovernmental Panel of Climate Change (IPCC), we have less than a decade to make massive and unprecedented changes in the global economy to avoid the worst impacts of climate change. To meet that challenge,Global Energy Monitor is creating trackers and other tools to provide detailed information on energy facilities, sponsors, and financing.

About Global Energy Monitor

Global Energy Monitor (GEM) is a global, independent nonprofit network of researchers tracking energy infrastructure worldwide, from power stations and coal mines to steel plants and shipping terminals, for the worldwide climate and clean energy movement.

Since its founding in 2007, GEM has become an essential resource for advancing a just energy transition, producing open-source data and analysis that drive transparency and informed action. Its work is widely used and cited across the climate and energy landscape, from Greenpeace and The Wall Street Journal to platforms like Bloomberg Terminals, and institutions including the International Energy Agency (IEA), IPCC, Climate Analytics, and Carbon Tracker Initiative.

GEM serves a broad community of stakeholders, including governments, financial institutions, journalists, researchers, and advocates, providing trusted, independent information that supports evidence-based decision-making and real-world impact.

Location

Preference will be given to those living in the United States, however, GEM may be able to hire employees worldwide in countries where our PEO (Deel) operates, except in countries classified as Level 3 or 4 on the
U.S. Department of State’s website. Additionally, due to regulatory and data security requirements, GEM cannot hire employees who will be working from China. GEM does not have a central office; instead, GEM works with employees to create suitable home offices catered to the needs of their role.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Project manage GEM’s editorial calendar, including timelines, contributors, approvals, and communications support for flagship releases such as Boom and Bust Coal and Pedal to the Metal.
  • Provide editorial guidance and maintain the quality, structure, and formatting of GEM reports and briefings.
  • Collaborate with the Communications Director and GEM programs to identify, develop, produce, and pitch compelling media stories based on GEM data.
  • Write and edit communications materials for editorial and product releases, including media pitches, press materials, web content, newsletters, and other external communications.
  • Collaborate with the Digital Communications Manager to translate reports and data into messaging frameworks that support GEM’s digital strategy and maximize the reach and impact of editorial and product releases.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Product and the Data Visualization Analyst to develop clear, accurate, and visually compelling charts, graphics, and other data-driven content.
  • Support media outreach, track coverage and impact, and provide additional communications support as organizational priorities evolve.

Required Qualifications

Applicants who tailor their resume and cover letter to these requirements will be prioritized. Applications at GEM are carefully reviewed by our team. We take the time to consider each candidate individually.

The following experience and skills are required for this position:

  • At least five years experience in communications or journalism.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects involving a variety of stakeholders.
  • Scrupulous attention to detail.
  • Strategic thinker with a track record of supporting organizational-wide change.
  • Fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An understanding of the energy and climate policy landscape.
  • Established network of journalists in the fields of climate, energy, and industry.
  • High-quality messaging skills, a knack for developing cohesive narratives, and a nose for finding stories.
  • Track record of pitching and publishing stories in top-tier media.
  • Ability to translate data into compelling narratives using strong writing skills.
  • Experience with journalism or working in a newsroom.
  • Experience with graphic design or data visualization technology for digital graphics (Flourish, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, etc.).
  • Experience with project management software such as Trello and Asana.

Visa Sponsorship Policy (Role Eligibility for US-Based Employees)

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require current or future employment-based visa sponsorship at any stage of employment.

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week, work-from-home position. The salary is $106,483.55 for locations in the United States.

Locations outside of the US: GEM aims to offer comparable salaries, benefits, and leave to employees living outside of the US in line with our fully transparent compensation framework. More information can be requested by contacting GEM’s People & Culture team.

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Marketing Analyst position is a mid-level role responsible for measuring, analyzing, and optimizing paid media investments to drive learner acquisition and revenue growth across Penn Foster Group’s portfolio of education brands. This role sits at the intersection of data and marketing strategy, translating complex campaign and attribution data into clear, actionable insights for marketing and business stakeholders. The analyst will work hands-on across platforms including Meta Ads, Google Ads, and Google Analytics (GA4), while leveraging SQL and Databricks to build scalable, reliable measurement infrastructure. A strong understanding of media measurement methodologies and Marketing Mix Modeling is essential to quantifying the true impact of media investment and informing strategic planning.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Analyzes performance marketing campaign data across paid search, paid social, and display channels (Google Ads, Meta) to identify optimization opportunities and inform media budget allocation decisions.
  • Builds, maintains, and automates reporting dashboards and data pipelines using SQL and Databricks to support ongoing measurement, performance monitoring, and stakeholder reporting.
  • Works with Marketing Mix Models (MMM) and attribution tools (e.g. Measured) to quantify the incremental impact of media spend across channels and support strategic media planning and budget recommendations.
  • Implements and manages tracking, tagging, and attribution frameworks within Google Analytics (GA4) to ensure accurate, consistent, and complete data capture across digital touchpoints.
  • Designs and analyzes A/B and incrementality tests in partnership with media and brand teams, translating results into clear, actionable optimization recommendations.
  • Monitors KPIs like CPA/CPM, ROAS, LTV, and conversion rates; and proactively surfaces meaningful trends, anomalies, and opportunities to marketing leadership.
  • Translates complex data findings into concise, compelling narratives and presentations for marketing and cross-functional stakeholders at varying levels of data fluency.
  • Supports media planning by providing audience insights, historical performance benchmarks, and channel-level forecasts to guide investment decisions.
  • Partners with data engineering and technology teams to ensure marketing data infrastructure is accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving measurement needs.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • 3–5 years of experience in performance marketing analytics, media measurement, or a closely related data-driven marketing role.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analysis; hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data platform required.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics (GA4), including event tracking, attribution modeling, and performance reporting.
  • Working knowledge of paid media platforms—specifically Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager—including campaign structure, bidding strategies, and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) concepts, methodologies, and practical application in a media planning or budget optimization context
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with a demonstrated ability to connect data insights to business strategy and outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings clearly and persuasively to non-technical audiences.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment & Hiring Requirements

  • U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role.
  • Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, etc. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed.
  • On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.
  • Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
  • Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
  • Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

About Us:

At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future.  Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in.

What We Offer:

We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, plus free access to all of our online programs
