jobs.description:
der moment

Seit 2018 hat Jurafuchs Hunderttausende Jurastudierende beim Lernen begleitet und ist heute die führende Lernplattform für juristische Bildung im deutschsprachigen Raum. Das Prinzip dahinter ist einfach: Komplexe Inhalte so aufbereiten, dass sie wirklich hängenbleiben.

Jetzt stellen wir uns eine neue Frage: Was wäre, wenn BWL-Studierende dasselbe erleben könnten?

Wer BWL studiert, kennt das Problem. Trockene Lehrbücher, unstrukturierte Skripte, Klausurvorbereitung auf gut Glück. Ein Lernprodukt, das wirklich an der Realität des Studiums andockt, gibt es nicht. Noch nicht. Den BWL-Fuchs bauen wir jetzt. Und wir suchen jemanden, der diese Lücke nicht nur kennt, sondern sie mit uns schließen will.

deine mission

Aus deiner Studierendenperspektive ein Lernprodukt mitbauen, das BWL-Studierenden wirklich hilft und das es so noch nicht gibt.

woran du bei uns arbeitest

Du hilfst uns, ein Produkt zu bauen, das an der Realität des BWL-Studiums andockt. Das zeigt sich zum Beispiel darin, dass:

  • klar wird, wo Studierende wirklich strugglen und warum bisherige Materialien dort versagen
  • Aufgaben, Fälle und Lernformate entstehen, die prüfungsrelevant und wirklich verständlich sind
  • erste Prototypen getestet, bewertet und iteriert werden
  • aus unstrukturierten Ideen klare Konzepte werden
  • du direkt mit den Gründern sparrst: inhaltlich, konzeptionell, strategisch

wer du bist

Du bist kein klassischer Werkstudent. Du bist jemand, der nicht wartet, bis eine Aufgabe kommt, sondern selbst erkennt, wo etwas gebraucht wird.

Du steckst mitten in einem wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Studium – ob BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsrecht, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder etwas Verwandtes – und weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was den meisten Kommilitonen schwerfällt, was prüfungsrelevant ist und wo man aufgibt. Genau diese Perspektive ist nicht nett-to-have. Sie ist der Kern dessen, was wir suchen.

Du denkst nicht in Aufgaben, sondern in Lösungen. Du kannst Komplexes einfach erklären, ohne es zu verfälschen. Und du hast Lust, Dinge auszuprobieren, auch wenn sie noch nicht fertig sind.

was du wissen solltest

Mindestens 10 Stunden pro Woche, mit der Perspektive auf 15–20 Stunden. 100 % remote. Enge, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründerteam, kein Mittelsmann, keine langen Abstimmungsschleifen. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bringst Struktur mit, wo noch keine ist.

was dich erwartet

Von Tag 1 an bist du mitten drin: in den Entscheidungen, in der Strategie, in den Gesprächen, die bestimmen, wie ein Produkt von Null auf entsteht. Du erlebst echtes Unternehmertum, nicht aus dem Lehrbuch, sondern in der Praxis. Wie man eine Idee in ein Produkt übersetzt. Wie man testet, scheitert und iteriert. Wie man aus Feedback lernt, bevor man zu viel gebaut hat. Was es bedeutet, mit begrenzten Ressourcen schnell und klug zu entscheiden. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern zusammen, keine langen Hierarchien, keine gefilterten Infos. Du siehst, wie ein ambitioniertes EdTech-Unternehmen von innen funktioniert, und sammelst Erfahrungen, die du in keinem Praktikum und in keinem Seminar bekommst.

Deine Arbeit wird sichtbar sein: in den Inhalten, die wegen dir verständlicher sind. In den Formaten, die wegen dir funktionieren. In dem Produkt, das ohne dich so nicht existieren würde.

Wenn du nicht einfach Aufgaben abarbeiten, sondern echtes Unternehmertum hautnah erleben und ein Produkt mitdenken willst, das Hunderttausende BWL-Studierende begleiten wird, dann wollen wir von dir hören.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

  • Location: Remote – UAE
  • Requirement: A Valid UAE work permit/employment visa is mandatory.
  • Employment type: Independent Contractor
Key Responsibilities
1. Generative AI & NLP for Engineering
  • Data Exploration and Analysis: Query and analyse large domain- or topic-specific data sets from both structured and unstructured sources, identify patterns and features. Ensure data meets quality standards and requirements before model development.
  • Regulation Text Interpretation: Design and fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) to parse complex regulatory texts (e.g., building codes, military standards) and extract structured rules for automated compliance checking.
  • Rule Formalization: Convert interpreted regulations into computer-processable formats (e.g., object-property-condition-value tuples) that can be executed by downstream compliance engines.
  • Querying via NLP: Architect methods for LLMs to map natural language requirements directly to specific metadata entities within various schemas (e.g., mapping "systems design" to specified attributes).
  • RAG Architecture: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that allow systems to query vast repositories of technical documentation and historical project data with high accuracy and low hallucination rates.
2. Predictive Modeling & Optimization (Supply Chain)
  • Forecasting Engines: Develop time-series forecasting models to predict spend categories and material demand by correlating internal ERP data with external macroeconomic signals.
  • Classification & Risk Scoring: Build machine learning classifiers to categorize supplier risks and operational anomalies, integrating data from diverse sources to create dynamic risk scores.
  • Data Extraction Pipelines: Design robust pipelines to extract and transform raw data (from Data Lakehouse, external web sources, or SAP and other databases) into features required for predictive modeling and automated rule checking.
3. System Integration & Performance
  • Model Orchestration: Work with Back End Engineers to integrate AI models into a cohesive "compliance engine" or "risk engine" that can be invoked programmatically via robust APIs.
  • Optimization: Streamline model performance to ensure complex checks (e.g., analyzing large datasets or processing thousands of supplier records) can be executed within reasonable timeframes, potentially using batching or asynchronous processing.
  • Quality Assurance: Validate model outputs against known test cases and historical data, debugging false positives/negatives to refine algorithms and ensure "defense-grade" reliability.

Requirements

  • Core AI/ML: Expert proficiency in Python and standard ML libraries (TensorFlow/PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy). Strong grasp of both supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
  • NLP & LLMs: Deep experience with transformer-based models (GPT, BERT, Llama) and prompt engineering techniques (few-shot learning, fine-tuning) for domain-specific tasks.
  • Data Engineering: Proficiency in handling complex data structures (JSON, XML) and familiarity with database querying (SQL/NoSQL) or graph data structures. Experience with data extraction from specialized formats is a significant plus.
  • Backend Awareness: Understanding of how to expose models via RESTful APIs (Flask/FastAPI) and integrate them into larger software architectures.
  • Statistics:Solid understanding of statistics, probability distribution, A/B testing. Adept at identifying and mitigating biases in datasets

This position will be based remotely on the East Coast- ideally in Pennsylvania or Massachusetts.

The Role:

Across industries, specialty chemicals are driving advances in performance, purity, and efficiency. Entegris is leading this shift, expanding rapidly into high-growth Specialty chemicals markets—including Life Sciences, Advanced Catalysts, and Semiconductor applications—to support the world’s most innovative manufacturers.

What You’ll Do

  • Influence pricing, investment, and resource allocation decisions through data-driven recommendations and business case development.

  • Influence senior leadership decision-making by providing data-driven insights on customer trends, risks, and growth opportunities

  • Prioritize accounts and opportunities based on revenue potential, strategic value, and return on investment to optimize resource allocation

  • Develop and execute competitive account strategies to defend market share and expand positioning within key customers

  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, sharing best practices in account management and strategic selling

  • Serve as the escalation point for critical customer issues, ensuring timely resolution and protection of strategic relationships

  • Own a territory/portfolio with primary markets in medical and pharmaceutical chemistry customers (including CDMOs, pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and oligo/phosphonamidite supply chains), and secondary markets in specialty applications utilizing metallocene catalysts.

  • Create and maintain account plans by mapping decisionmakers, identifying growth levers, assessing risks, and analyzing competitors; own revenue targets and pipeline development while driving product line growth and margin expansion.

  • Champion disciplined commercial excellence, including value-based pricing and margin optimization.

  • Support continuous improvement across commercial processes, including forecasting, change control, and customer communication.

  • Partner with PM’s/R&D to address performance questions, quality deviations, and continuous-improvement opportunities; close the loop with documented outcomes.

  • Develop and execute territory-level growth strategies aligned with broader business objectives, identifying new market opportunities and expanding customer segments.

  • Drive revenue growth planning by proactively identifying new business opportunities, developing pipeline strategies, and expanding into adjacent applications and markets.

Experience selling to pharmaceutical environments and CDMOs, ideally within oligonucleotide or high-purity reagent supply chains; exposure to organometallics is a plus (PhD could be an asset as well when selling into fine chemicals market).

jobs.description:
Who We Are 
Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit www.marketbridge.com and follow www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/.

Who We're Looking For
We are building an AI-powered operating system that is driving innovation across B2B Marketing, and we are looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to help lead the build. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to the product: owning major parts of the platform end to end, shipping them fast, and setting the bar for how we build.

Product management has changed, and this role sits at the center of that change. The distance between an idea and a working prototype is now measured in days, not sprints. You will move at that pace, using AI to compress the lifecycle and turn direction into shipped software. If you have spent the last few years learning to build this way, you will do some of the best work of your career here.

Responsibilities
You will take the product direction set for our operating system and turn it into working software, owning the delivery of major parts of the platform and setting the standard for how the team builds.

  • Ownership. Own the roadmap and delivery for one or more major areas of the platform: the data layer, the skills and agents layer, the context layer or the solutions that support our agency and consutling services.

  • Execution. Turn direction into shipped software. Write the specs, build the prototypes, drive end-to-end testing, and establish the ground truths the rest of the work depends on.

  • Standards. Set the bar for how we build. Drive spec-driven development and Product Requirement Docs, and hold quality high while moving fast.

  • Pace. Compress the distance between an idea and a shipped product, using AI across the full lifecycle.

  • Partnership. Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, analytics, and creative teams to move ideas into production quickly, and mentor the product talent around you.

This role builds. If the phrase vibe coding makes you lean in, you will feel at home here. The engineering team supporting you can move at speed, and the ideas you prototype with stakeholders can be translated into features and functionality that ship into production fast.

How we work
We run on PRD to prototype to spec-driven development, and we move fast because our tooling lets us. Claude and OpenAI are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. Notion is where our thinking lives. Figma is where our product takes shape. Monday is where manage the work, We have a real process already in place, refined through building, and you will need to absorb it quickly and then help make it better.

What we are looking for
You have real product management experience, the kind that taught you how to find the problem, ship the thing, and stand behind the outcome. Then you learned to build with AI, and you can show us what that looks like in practice, not just in theory.

  • Depth in product management. Years of owning products and shipping them, with outcomes attached, not just scope.

  • A real transition to AI-native work. Concrete evidence of using AI to accelerate the full product lifecycle, with results you can point to.

  • Strong hands-on building. This role builds. You are comfortable prototyping yourself, working spec-first, and moving from idea to working software fast.

  • Fluency with a modern product stack. Claude, OpenAI, Notion, Figma, Monday, Product Requirement Docs, and spec-driven workflows.

  • The ability to integrate quickly. We already have a working process. You can plug in from day one, then help improve it.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including time owning complex products end to end.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on experience with Claude, OpenAI, and other AI tools and platforms.

  • A track record of shipping products on fast timelines, ideally in service-driven or agency-model environments.

  • Familiarity with how AI is reshaping marketing workflows across:

  • Media strategy and optimization

  • Creative automation and personalization

  • Commerce and customer journey performance

  • Marketing analytics and business intelligence

  • Experience with martech or adtech platforms, cloud-based data environments, or analytics frameworks is a plus.

  • Commerce and customer journey performance

  • Marketing analytics and business intelligence

  • Familiarity with enterprise AI ecosystems, martech , revops and adtech platforms, cloud-based environments (AWS / Databricks), and analytics frameworks.

  • A demonstrated ability to bridge technical AI concepts with executive-level business strategy.

  • Experience supporting enterprise solution architecture and change management.

Who you will work with
You will report to the VP of Product Management and work at the center of a small, technical team building something new. The people around you move fast and build with their hands. We are looking for someone who wants to be one of them and help lead them.

Our Culture & Our Core Values

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. Be Kind means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. Be Open reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. Be Real speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. Be Brave pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

Benefits & Perks 

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to: 

  • 🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible Time Off, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug. 

  • 💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness. 

  • 💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind. 

  • 📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career. 

  • 💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, ChatGPT Enterprise Access and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis. 

Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. 

Marketbridge is committed to providing competitive, equitable compensation that reflects the responsibilities of the role, market conditions, and each candidate's unique qualifications. The anticipated base salary for this position is $150,000.

This role focuses on building and enhancing IAM capabilities such as identity lifecycle management, role and entitlement models, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, access controls, and system integrations across enterprise platforms.

This engineer will play a key role in developing custom solutions and automation for platforms such as Okta, Salesforce, and ServiceNow, Azure, and AWS with an emphasis on secure integration patterns, operational reliability, and long-term maintainability. The role works closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application owners, and business stakeholders to translate IAM and business requirements into practical technical solutions that improve security, reduce manual effort, and support business growth.

ali

    • Design, build, and maintain custom IAM applications, APIs, services, and automation that support identity lifecycle management, role-based access, entitlement management, and provisioning workflows.
    • Develop full stack solutions that enable secure identity orchestration, access automation, and administrative workflows across platforms including Okta, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and other enterprise applications.
    • Experience mentoring or leading developers, with the ability to help junior team members build IAM domain expertise
    • Experience owning or contributing to SDLC process standards and continuous improvement for a development team.
      Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience representing a technical team's services and standards to partner product owners and other development teams.
    • Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, business application owners, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into secure, scalable technical designs.
    • Design and implement integrations between IAM platforms, enterprise systems, HR-driven workflows, ticketing systems, and internal tools using APIs, web services, event-driven patterns, and data transformation logic.
    • Build and support solutions related to identity attributes, access roles, group management, entitlement assignment, and policy-driven automation.
    • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and operational support.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, defects, integration failures, provisioning issues, and access-related incidents while improving system stability and supportability.
    • Ensure IAM solutions are designed with strong security controls, auditability, resilience, and scalability in mind.
    • Contribute to technical standards, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering practices that improve solution quality and reduce risk.
    • Support testing and validation efforts, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing of IAM workflows and provisioning logic.
    • Maintain technical documentation for system designs, workflows, integration points, and operational procedures.
    • Stay current with IAM trends, security practices, and modern software engineering approaches, and recommend improvements where appropriate.

Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including several years of hands-on experience building custom IAM, access automation, or enterprise integration solutions.

    • Practical experience developing and supporting solutions that integrate with enterprise platforms such as identity providers, IT service management systems, CRM platforms, HR systems, or related business applications.

    • Experience developing secure integrations and APIs across platforms such as Okta, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and other enterprise systems.

    • Experience building automated provisioning, deprovisioning, and access governance solutions.

      Preferred

      • 7+ years of experience designing and delivering custom IAM software solutions in a complex enterprise environment.

      • Certifications: CISSP, IDPro, CCSP, CIMP, Okta Certified Professional or Developer, MS Azure SC-300, AWS CCP, AWS CSA

      • Experience utilizing AI tools to create and test custom automation agents.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

    • Strong full stack software development experience with two or more modern programming languages such as Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, or similar technologies.

    • Strong understanding of IAM concepts, including identity lifecycle management, provisioning and deprovisioning, roles, group-based access, entitlements, least privilege, segregation of duties, and access control models.

    • Experience designing and building custom IAM workflows and automation for user onboarding, job changes, termination processing, and access requests.

    • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and identity-related security principles.

    • Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, system-to-system integrations, and data exchange patterns.

    • Strong understanding of secure software development practices, including logging, error handling, secrets protection, input validation, and testing.

    • Familiarity with modern software architecture and engineering practices, including modular design, version control, CI/CD, automated testing, and code review.

    • Experience working with relational databases, data models, and query development.

    • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, especially in diagnosing complex workflow, integration, and access issues.

    • Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and tools such as Jira.

    • Ability to balance technical design, delivery speed, operational support, and long-term maintainability.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, security teams, and business stakeholders.

The RN Case Manager plays a critical role in optimizing patient care and resource utilization. The incumbent is responsible for assessing, planning, implementing, coordinating, monitoring, and evaluating comprehensive care plans to meet individual health needs. Requirements

EDUCATION

Bachelor's degree in Nursing preferred.

LICENSING/CERTIFICATION

Registered Nurse (RN) with current active state license in good standing in the state(s) where job duties are performed required.

Case management certification required. If certification is not obtained prior to employment, must obtain URAC recognized within three (3) years of hire as a RN Case Manager. The acceptable case management certifications are Certified Case Manager (CCM), Accredited Case Manager (ACM), and Registered Nurse - Board Certified (RN-BC).

KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

Minimum four (4) years' clinical practice experience in at least one of the following areas: case management, home health, critical care, medical/surgical, discharge planning, concurrent review, or obstetric/neonatal care.

Independence

Detail oriented

Skills

jobs.excerpt: Who we areVetcor is a community-centric veterinary services company supporting over 900 practices across the US and Canada.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Vetcor is a community-centric veterinary services company supporting over 900 practices across the US and Canada. Vetcor practices thrive with access to a collaborative network while staying true to themselves and their community. All Vetcor practices have a shared goal of providing excellent care and service to both patients and clients in their communities. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a skilled and experienced Security Operations Manager to join our team and lead the security of our operations, data, and facilities.

About the Role

The Security Operations Manager will lead the day-to-day operations of Vetcor's security operations, with expanded oversight of data security, vulnerability management, and security awareness. This role requires a professional with extensive experience in security operations, incident response, threat management, and information security more broadly. The Security Operations Manager will manage security operations partners and processes, and will work closely with IT, legal, and other departments to ensure a secure and resilient environment across Vetcor's practices.

The Work

Operations Management

  • Oversee the daily operations of the Managed Detection and Response Partner.
  • Manage and monitor security technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and SIEM solutions.
  • Ensure the timely detection, analysis, and response to security incidents.

Incident Response

  • Develop and maintain incident response plans and procedures.
  • Lead the response to security incidents, including investigations, reporting, and remediation.
  • Conduct regular drills and training exercises to ensure preparedness.

Threat Management

  • Monitor and analyze threat intelligence to identify potential security threats.
  • Implement and manage threat detection and prevention technologies.
  • Conduct penetration testing and red-team exercises to validate defenses.

Vulnerability Management

  • Own the end-to-end vulnerability management program, including scanning, assessment, and prioritization of findings across infrastructure and applications.
  • Coordinate timely remediation and patching with IT and practice-level stakeholders, tracking issues to closure against defined SLAs.
  • Report on vulnerability posture, trends, and remediation metrics to leadership.

Data Security

  • Develop and maintain data security policies, including data classification, encryption, and access control standards.
  • Implement and monitor data loss prevention (DLP) controls to protect sensitive patient, client, and business data.
  • Partner with IT and practice leadership to ensure secure handling of data across systems, vendors, and integrations.

Security Awareness

  • Design and deliver a company-wide security awareness program, including onboarding training and ongoing employee education.
  • Run phishing simulations and other awareness campaigns and track and report on employee engagement and risk trends.
  • Develop role-specific training content for high-risk teams and communicate emerging threats in accessible, practical terms.

Risk Management and Compliance

  • Conduct risk assessments to identify potential security threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures to mitigate identified risks.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards (e.g., PCI, SOX).

Collaboration and Communication

  • Collaborate with IT, legal, and other departments to address security needs and concerns.
  • Communicate security updates, policies, and procedures to all employees.

  • Manage cloud networking components including VPCs, load balancers, DNS, Cloud Router, NAT, and firewall rules

The On-Call Pharmacy Technician provides professional after-hours (or within business hours if needed) operational support to ensure continuity of patient care when the pharmacy is closed. Working under the supervision of the Pharmacist-in-Charge (PIC) and in compliance with California pharmacy regulations, this role serves as the first point of contact for after-hours patient inquiries, triages requests based on urgency, coordinates communication with the on-call pharmacist, and facilitates prescription transfers when clinically appropriate. The technician is also responsible for coordinating medication home deliveries through approved third-party delivery partners to support timely patient access to medications.

This position will support our SHAW and Modesto pharmacies.

Schedule requires 24 hour availability.

Compensation: $23.56 – $26.92 an hour

Golden Valley Health Centers offers excellent benefits including Medical: (0 Deductible / $2,000 Individual; $4,000 Family Out-of-Pocket Max), excellent PPO coverages; Dental; Vision; 403(b) with match, FSA plans, gym discounts, and so much more!

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Under the supervision of a pharmacist this position will do all tasks approved by the board of pharmacy as a regular pharmacy technician.
  • After-Hours Patient Support
  • Serve as the primary after-hours contact for patient phone calls when the pharmacy is closed.
  • Professionally assess the nature and urgency of incoming patient requests using established pharmacy protocols.
  • Collect and accurately document all relevant patient information, including medication details, pharmacy information, contact information, and reason for the request.
  • Escalate urgent medication-related matters to the on-call pharmacist promptly.
  • Ensure all after-hours communications and actions are accurately documented for follow-up by the pharmacy team on the next business day.
  • Prescription Transfer Coordination
  • Gather all necessary information required for prescription transfer requests.
  • Coordinate communication between patients and the on-call pharmacist to facilitate prescription transfers to alternate pharmacies when immediate medication access is required, in accordance with California Board of Pharmacy regulations.
  • Communicate updates to patients regarding the status of their requests.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records of all transfer-related communications.
  • Home Delivery Coordination
  • Schedule medication deliveries through home delivery drivers.
  • Verify delivery requests, patient contact information, and delivery addresses prior to dispatch.
  • Coordinate delivery timing with patients and delivery vendors.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve operational issues as needed.
  • Ensure all deliveries comply with pharmacy policies, HIPAA requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
  • Documentation & Communication
  • Maintain detailed records of all patient interactions, delivery requests, prescription transfer requests, and pharmacist communications.
  • Prepare comprehensive handoff documentation for the pharmacy team at the beginning of the next business day.
  • Communicate professionally with patients, pharmacists, healthcare providers, and delivery partners.
  • Compliance & Quality
  • Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA privacy and confidentiality requirements.
  • Follow all California Board of Pharmacy regulations governing pharmacy technician practice.
  • Adhere to company policies, standard operating procedures, and quality assurance standards.

  • Maintain professionalism, accuracy, and patient-centered service during all patient interactions.

About the team

Zillow's Agent Sales organization helps real estate professionals succeed with the solutions and technology they need in a dynamic market. The Revenue Strategy & Operations team is the strategy and execution engine behind that work, building AI-powered capabilities, scalable systems, and operating models that let Zillow's go-to-market teams grow without friction.
The GTM Productivity function operates across three focused pillars: GTM Systems, GTM Governance & Deal Operations, and Process Architecture. This role leads Process Architecture, the upstream design work that the other two pillars depend on to build, integrate, and govern effectively.

About the role

We're seeking a singular authority on GTM process architecture reporting to the Director of GTM Productivity. You will define how Zillow's sales and customer success workflows operate, set the design standards that GTM Systems builds to, and own the process blueprint that governs how work flows across the entire GTM motion.

This is not a Salesforce admin or hands-on engineer role. System builds and integrations sit with GTM product and engineering teams. But you bring enough technical fluency to design processes that are practical to build, speak credibly with engineers and product managers about trade-offs, and ensure your process designs survive contact with the real technology stack.

Your output is the authoritative process blueprint: swim-lane designs, decision trees, workflow specs, and implementation requirements that are practical to build, easy to adopt, and directly tied to seller productivity outcomes. There is no peer in this function; you set the standard.

What You'll Own

GTM Process Design

  • Own the design of core sales workflows, lead routing, opportunity type and progression, pipeline hygiene, activity capture, and the handoff from Sales to Customer Success.

  • Map the full current-state lead-to-close journey, identifying friction points, redundant steps, manual workarounds, and automation opportunities.

  • Define future-state process blueprints: swim-lane diagrams, decision trees, exception paths, and field-level data standards ready for implement.

  • Maintain a prioritized process improvement roadmap sequenced by seller impact and implementation feasibility.

  • Own the intake and triage of process-change requests from Sales, CS, and Enablement, translating field feedback into scoped design problems.

Seller Productivity & Outcomes

  • Define non-selling time per rep as the north-star metric, every design decision is evaluated against whether it reduces admin burden or eliminates a manual step.

  • Design lightweight KPIs and leading indicators for each workflow, partnering with BI to surface them in existing dashboards rather than creating new reporting infrastructure.

  • Run regular workflow-health reviews with Sales and CS field teams to catch adoption breakdowns or process drift before they become systemic.

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Serve as the upstream design partner for the technical team, producing implementation-ready specs that product, engineers and admins can act on without re-interpreting the intent.

  • Coordinate with Governance & Deal Ops to ensure process designs include the right control points and data integrity checkpoints without over-engineering the seller flow.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering at the design stage, before features are built, so new GTM capabilities land cleanly into existing workflows.

  • Drive change management for process launches in partnership with Enablement: communications, training briefs, and adoption tracking.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $109,000.00 - $174,000.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $103,500.00 - $165,300.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 5 - 8 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations with a process and systems design role within a SaaS or technology company.

  • Exposure to AI or automation tools in a GTM context, you've thought about where AI outputs belong in a rep workflow, not just that AI exists.

  • A track record of designing GTM workflows that shipped and were adopted, you've seen your blueprints go live and measured what happened afterward.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce architecture: objects, relationships, record types, flows, and automation logic, well enough to design for the platform without being the one to build on it.

  • Experience translating process designs into business requirements that CRM admins, product and engineers could act on directly.

  • Familiarity with the broader GTM tech stack (Gainsight, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, Highspot) at a workflow level: how reps use these tools day-to-day and how data moves between them.

  • Systems thinking: you understand how upstream process changes ripple into data quality, reporting, and rep behavior, and you design to minimize unintended consequences.

  • Data fluency: comfortable with SQL or BI tools (Tableau, Looker) to validate workflow data quality and measure adoption.

  • Structured communicator: you produce a one-page swim-lane that a VP of Sales immediately understands and a Salesforce architect can implement — same document, two audiences.

  • Comfortable operating at the boundary between strategy and execution, you hold the design standard without being precious when field reality requires pragmatism.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Risk and judgement

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We're building a new SRE team and looking for founding members to help shape how we operate. As a Lead SRE, you’ll be a technical and operational leader for reliability across Develocity. You’ll help define our SRE vision, set standards for how we operate production services, and mentor other SREs as the team grows. This is a hands-on role with broad influence across engineering, cloud platform, and customer-facing teams.

The SRE team will be responsible for the reliability, performance, and availability of Develocity instances serving paying customers, open-source projects, and public-facing services, plus supporting infrastructure like artifact registries.

You'll work on our internally-built Cloud Application Platform, Kubernetes on AWS, and develop deep expertise in it. When incidents happen, you'll troubleshoot issues across the stack, from application to infrastructure. You'll collaborate with the Cloud Platform team to improve the tooling you depend on, and with engineering teams to build reliability into how we ship software. If you like automating things and hate doing the same task twice, you'll fit in well.

You'll be part of a distributed, remote-first team that values asynchronous communication and written documentation. Strong self-direction and clear communication across time zones are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain all Develocity instances and supporting services in production.
  • Define and evolve SRE standards, practices, and operating models, including on-call, incident response, postmortems, and SLOs.
  • Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, acting as a technical escalation point for complex or high-severity incidents.
  • Lead incident response and blameless retrospectives, ensuring learnings result in measurable reliability improvements.
  • Set reliability priorities using risk, customer impact, business goals, SLOs, and error budgets.
  • Identify systemic reliability risks and continuously evolve Develocity’s SaaS operations as the platform and customer base grow.
  • Lead and influence architectural and design reviews to ensure reliability, scalability, and operability.
  • Drive automation across deployment, upgrades, monitoring, self-healing, recovery, and operational workflows.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive observability for all managed services, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • Own disaster recovery, backups, and business continuity planning and execution.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to balance feature delivery with reliability and operational excellence.
  • Mentor and coach SREs, supporting technical growth and strong operational practices.
  • Help onboard new SREs and contribute to hiring by defining and assessing SRE excellence at Develocity.
  • Communicate clearly with customers during incidents and maintenance windows.
  • Optimize performance, resource utilization, and operational costs.

Minimum qualifications

  • 7+ years in SRE, DevOps, or an equivalent role operating production services at scale.
  • Experience leading reliability initiatives across multiple teams or services.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction without direct authority.
  • Experience designing and operating systems with SLOs and error budgets, and exercising strong judgment in balancing reliability, velocity, and cost.
  • Strong Kubernetes experience in production environments.
  • Cloud infrastructure expertise, preferably AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, EC2).
  • Proficiency with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Track record of incident management and response in a 24/7 on-call environment.
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, Bash) for automation.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience as a founding or early SRE establishing practices in a growing SaaS organization.
  • Familiarity with Develocity.
  • JVM language experience (Java, Kotlin).
  • Experience with customer-facing and executive-level incident communications.

What We Offer

  • A ground-floor role in a new SRE team - you'll shape how we do things, not inherit someone else's decisions.
  • Real ownership of production systems used by engineers at companies you've heard of.
  • Direct interaction with customers when things go wrong (and when they go right).
  • A culture that values automation over heroics.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings.
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Location

  • While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

jobs.excerpt: Jito's engineering team has already rebuilt how it works around AI, and the gain in output is real.
jobs.description:
Jito's engineering team has already rebuilt how it works around AI, and the gain in output is real. Everywhere else in the company, that same gain sits uncaptured. This role exists to go get it, with a company-wide mandate from day one.

Jito builds the market layer of Solana. We run the validator client behind a majority of the network's stake, JitoSOL, BAM, and JTX. About 40 people. Ops, legal, finance, marketing, business development, and product each have well-understood, expensive workflow problems that a strong engineer could solve in a week, and today those problems sit unowned or get picked up as side work.

You would be the first dedicated AI engineer at Jito Labs.

We're a small team with product-market fit. That means:

  • High ownership: every team member drives significant technical decisions and shapes our roadmap.
  • Fast execution: we ship rapidly and iterate based on real-world feedback. Progress, not motion.
  • High quality bar: the details are the product. We don't trade them for speed.

About the Position

    You'll work with the CEO and with teams across the company to find the highest-leverage work. Some of that is problems people already know they have. Much of it is optimization they've stopped noticing, in processes that function well enough that nobody has questioned them. This role owns the cross-cutting investments no single team will prioritize, and builds for the teams that can't build for themselves.

    The default is to buy and configure where something off the shelf does the job, and to build where nothing does. Everything you ship carries a named maintainer and clear criteria for when to sunset it.

    A meaningful part of the role is spent with the people doing the work, engineers included, in enough depth to understand where their time actually goes. From there you scope it, build it, secure it, roll it out, and keep it running.

    Security owns the platform layer. You own the applications built on top of it, in partnership with Security from design time forward.

    This is a mid-to-senior individual contributor role, roughly three to five years of experience. It is not a research or model-training position.

    Reports to the CEO.

What Makes This Hard

  • The surface area is the whole company. Every team has a different workflow, a different data shape, and a different tolerance for a tool that gets it right most of the time. Doing this well means understanding how Jito actually runs, team by team, including the optimizations that people inside a process have stopped seeing.
  • Buying is usually correct and rarely sufficient on its own. Finding the seam between configuring a vendor and building it yourself is most of the judgment this role requires.
  • Adoption is a people problem before it's an engineering one. The strongest model users at any company are well ahead of the median, and closing that distance takes teaching and documentation as much as code.
  • Security and speed pull against each other, constantly. We are infrastructure that validators and stakers depend on, and we take that seriously, so anything touching internal data gets designed with Security from the start. Judging where the extra week is worth spending, and where it isn't, is a large part of this role.

What We're Looking For

  • Three to five years shipping and operating production services. You can stand up VM sandboxes, MCP servers, and vendor LLM integrations, and you'll pass an engineering screen.
  • LLM and agent tooling you've shipped that people use today. We'll ask who uses it and how often. Prototypes nobody adopted won't clear the bar.
  • Buy-first instincts with the range to build. You can explain your last custom build and why it was necessary, and you've sunset projects of your own.
  • The ability to sit with someone in Legal, Finance, or Marketing, extract the real workflow, and ship something they use every week, without a PM translating for you.
  • Judgment about which teams are actually drowning, and the restraint to avoid pushing tools on people who didn't ask.
  • Security at design time by reflex, with constraints treated as parameters of the design.
  • You think like an operator. The most interesting problem and the highest-impact problem are frequently different ones, and you can tell which is which. Getting nerd sniped by a hard technical problem that saves the company an hour a month is the failure mode here.
  • Self-directed prioritization. You surface use cases, estimate their impact, rank them with the CEO, and say no. There is real work waiting on day one, and the expectation is that you find more of it than anyone hands you.
  • Operational ownership. You maintain what you ship, and have clear kill criteria for each project to avoid unnecessary maintenance burden.
  • The prospect of 40 people producing the output of 400 reads as interesting to you.

    • Blockchain experience is not required.

Relevant Background

    If you have experience in any of the following, you may be a good fit:

  • OpenHands, Langchain or coding agent frameworks, deployed and maintained in a real environment
  • Building and operating MCP servers
  • CLI tooling and automation that other engineers picked up and kept using
  • Security and network operations: identity, secrets management, egress control, sandboxing
  • Connecting existing systems into something that holds up under real use, and recognizing when to write it yourself instead
  • Being the only person in your function at a company under 50 people
  • Owning a vendor surface: spend, data exposure, renewals
  • Rust, Python, TypeScript or a systems background
  • Linux systems and DevOps experience
  • Crypto or Solana literacy

jobs.excerpt: SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.
jobs.description:
SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. SmartBug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

Role Overview

    The AVP of Client Account Management is the leader responsible for the stability, health, and long-term growth of the SmartBug client portfolio. This role primarily oversees the Account Management vertical, ensuring that every client relationship is managed with strategic foresight to maximize Lifetime Value (LTV) and overall "stickiness." As the primary architect of the "Relationship Layer," you will transform the Account Management function from administrative coordination into a proactive, "trusted advisor" model that anticipates client needs and mitigates churn risks before they surface. By leveraging the HubSpot partnership ecosystem and deeply embedding our strategic value into the client's operational DNA, you will ensure SmartBug remains an indispensable extension of their team.

Key Responsibilities

    Role Focus

    Responsibilities

    Strategic Relationship & Retention Management

    • Retention & Health Ownership: Own the Net Retention Rate (NRR) and Gross Retention Rate (GRR) metrics. Develop proactive "Early Warning Systems" to identify and pivot accounts at risk.

    • HubSpot Partnership Stewardship: Own the executive-level relationship with the HubSpot partner ecosystem to maximize the use of HubSpot resources (such as Channel Account Managers and technical enablement kits). Utilize these internal HubSpot connections to improve stickiness and the overall HubSpot relationship.

    • Relationship Stickiness: Design frameworks that move AMs from "order takers" to "strategic partners," ensuring we are embedded in the client’s long-term business roadmap.

    • LTV Optimization: Analyze client lifecycles to maximize value, identifying opportunities for expansion and reducing churn through superior service delivery.

    • Account Planning & Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs): Standardize and oversee the QBR process across the AM team. Ensure that every QBR translates technical milestones into business ROI that resonates with a client’s C-suite.

    • Commercial Growth: Own the "Expansion" portion of Net Revenue Retention. Partner with Sales and Strategy to identify whitespace within the existing portfolio and coach Account Managers on identifying and closing organic growth opportunities.

    • Commercial & Scope Governance: Partner with the VP of Operations to monitor and optimize the Effective Billing Rate (EBR) across the client portfolio. Ensure Account Managers are maintaining high commercial discipline by preventing "scope creep" and over-servicing, ensuring that client health never comes at the expense of departmental profit margins.

    Leadership & AM Excellence

    • Team Architecture: Oversee the entire Account Management vertical. Recruit, mentor, and scale a team capable of managing complex, high-touch relationships.

    • The "SmartBug Way" Standardization: Define and refine the Client Journey Map from handoff to renewal. Ensure a consistent "SmartBug" experience at every touchpoint, standardizing how AMs communicate wins, handle escalations, and manage HubSpot-specific milestones.

    • Performance Metrics: Define and track KPIs beyond just revenue—focusing on NPS/CSAT, client health scores, and referral rates.

    Cross-Functional Strategic Collaboration

    • The "Golden Triangle": Work in lockstep with the VP of Strategy (to align client goals with our execution) and the PMO/Delivery Leaders (to ensure what we sell is delivered with excellence).

    • High-Level Resource Advocacy: Act as the primary advocate for the client portfolio during internal resource allocation and capacity planning sessions. Partner with the VP of Ops and PMO to ensure that team assignments align with the client’s long-term strategic needs and relationship health.

    • Feedback Loops: Act as the "Voice of the Client" internally, funneling client feedback into the Product and Delivery teams to influence our service evolution.

    Operational Infrastructure

    • CRM Mastery: Use HubSpot as the single source of truth. Oversee the creation of dashboards that track client health, contract renewals, and AM touchpoints.

    • Data-Driven Decisions: Use HubSpot data to forecast churn risks and identify "expansion-ready" accounts.

    • AI Adoption: Champion internal AI fluency to streamline client communication and reporting, leveraging AI agents to increase team efficiency.

Required Skills & Experience

    • Client Retention & Health Mastery: Proven track record of owning and improving Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) within an agency or professional services environment.

    • Strategic Account Leadership: Deep expertise in moving client relationships from tactical execution to strategic partnership, focusing on increasing Lifetime Value (LTV) and "stickiness."

    • Executive Presence: Ability to serve as a high-level escalation point and a "trusted advisor" to C-suite client stakeholders (CEO, CMO, CFO).

    • Operational Performance Management: Experience defining and managing KPIs that drive proactive account management, such as client health scores, referral rates, and expansion revenue.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with PMO, Strategy, and Delivery leaders to ensure the "Golden Triangle" of relationship, roadmap, and execution is balanced.

    • Conflict Resolution & Mediation: Advanced skills in navigating complex client challenges and internal resource constraints to find win-win solutions.

    • Team Mentorship: A history of leading and scaling high-performing Account Management teams, with a focus on coaching AMs to lead with business value.

    • HubSpot Expert Practitioner: Deep familiarity with the HubSpot ecosystem, ability to speak to and utilize HubSpot

Preferred Qualifications

    • Agency Experience: Direct experience in a fast-paced agency environment, understanding the nuances of billable hours, project-based delivery, and retainer-based relationships.

    • Data-Driven Storytelling: Proficiency in translating complex data (from HubSpot or BI tools) into compelling narratives for both internal leadership and client stakeholders.

    • AI Fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Gemini, HubSpot AI, or meeting assistants) to improve team efficiency and client reporting accuracy.

    • Vertical Expertise: Specialized knowledge in one or more of SmartBug’s core verticals (e.g., Technology, SaaS, Healthcare, or Professional Services).

    • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; MBA or advanced leadership certification is a plus.

jobs.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:

The Finance Specialist for North and South Carolina provides advanced financial management support across the shared services unit (pod), partnering with the Finance Manager, Finance Director, and business unit staff to deliver high-quality financial services. This role supports one or more states or organizational areas within the pod, providing shared finance expertise that flexes to meet business priorities and operational needs. The Finance Specialist serves as a trusted partner by delivering financial analysis, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and other financial management activities while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and best practices.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The Finance Specialist provides advanced financial support across assigned states, programs, or business units within a shared services pod. Working collaboratively with the Finance Manager and the Finance Director, the position supports budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, month- and year-end close activities, financial analysis, and ongoing financial management. The role develops a strong understanding of assigned business operations and provides timely financial guidance to support informed decision-making.

The Finance Specialist administers financial activities in accordance with TNC policies, procedures, and financial management best practices. The position prepares analyses, reconciliations, and reports; monitors financial performance; identifies trends, risks, and opportunities; and recommends process improvements to enhance efficiency, consistency, and stewardship of organizational resources. The role responds to moderately complex financial questions and serves as a resource to staff on finance processes, systems, and reporting.

Work Arrangement: This role is remote with preference to the Eastern or Central time zones.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Supports budgeting, forecasting, financial close, reporting, and other core financial management activities across assigned states or business units within the pod, and may assist in supporting other Southern Division business units or pods as the need arises.

  • Prepares and delivers financial reports, analyses, reconciliations, and other financial deliverables that support operational and strategic decision-making.

  • Monitors financial performance, identifies trends, variances, risks, and opportunities, and communicates findings and recommendations to Finance Managers, Finance Directors, and business leaders.

  • Maintains the accuracy, integrity, and quality of financial data, reporting, systems, and business processes.

  • Supports compliance with organizational policies, internal controls, audit requirements, donor restrictions, and applicable regulatory requirements while identifying and escalating potential issues.

  • Provides guidance to staff on finance processes, systems, reporting tools, and standard operating procedures and may coordinate or deliver training as needed.

  • Partners with the Finance Manager, the Finance Director, Operations, Conservation, and Philanthropy staff to support financial planning, implementation of organizational priorities, and effective stewardship of resources.

  • Contributes to finance initiatives, process improvements, system implementations, and cross-functional projects that enhance consistency and effectiveness across the pod.

We’re Looking for You:

Are you looking for work you can believe in? At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of Work that You Can Believe in where you can feel like you are making a difference every day. We’re looking for someone with strong experience in leading a diverse, multi-disciplinary team.

The ideal candidate should have exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience in management of controls and reports of a business unit. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the ongoing mission of conservation by directing and shaping the work of our team!

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field and 3 years' related experience or equivalent combination.

  • Experience with accounting/financial issues and analysis.

  • Experience using accounting and financial reporting systems.

  • Technical experience with spreadsheet programs, general ledger reports and financial management tools.

  • Experience with GAAP, practices and regulations.

  • Experience, coursework or other training with U.S. Federal Uniform Guidance, state and local regulations, multilateral and international regulations, and standard contract clauses, as applicable.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Multi-lingual skills and/or multi-cultural experience appreciated.

  • Ability to manipulate, analyze and interpret data. Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel.

  • Strong organizational skills.

  • Accuracy, attention to detail and the ability to multi-task.

  • Non-profit accounting experience.

  • May require technical expertise on complex accounting/financial issues.

  • US government grants accounting experience.

This position requires a valid driver's license and compliance with TNC’s Auto Safety Program. Employees may not drive Conservancy-owned/leased vehicles, rental cars, or personal vehicles on behalf of the Conservancy if considered "high risk drivers." To learn more about the Auto Safety Program, visit the Auto Safety information page. Employment in this position will be contingent upon completion of a Vehicle Use Agreement, which may include a review of the prospective employee's motor vehicle record.

Salary Information:

The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $68,000 – $85,000 annually. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

about us

velpTEC is an education institute focused on innovative technologies, combining experience from business, future studies, and new educational approaches. Through our educational offerings, we support people in strengthening their skills for the future in a practice-oriented way, helping them actively shape their own paths in life – and from 2027 onward, also in higher education.
VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) is a private university of applied sciences currently undergoing the process of state recognition through the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture. Our degree programs are launching in the fields of digital technologies, engineering, and innovation-driven management – with a clear commitment to continuously expanding our portfolio and responding to new developments. We understand teaching as a space for shaping solutions for tomorrow. Our approach is project-based, competency-oriented, and closely interlinked with practice. We are looking for individuals who are eager to break new ground in higher education and want to actively help shape our innovative learning environment.
We are filling a W2-Professorship in Data Science and Digital Systems (100%).

your responsibilities

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Master's program in Technology Business Management, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on big data, business intelligence, cloud infrastructures, and data-driven technologies in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and master's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of data science, data infrastructures, and digital transformation – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration

recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):
  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Data Science, or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in data analytics, digital systems, or data-driven business processes

in addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.

in addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in data science and digital systems education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in AI, blockchain, robotics, and management
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to implementing data science solutions or digital infrastructures in real-world contexts
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate global developments in data and system sciences into teaching and research
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in big data analytics, cloud systems, AI-based data analysis, or digital infrastructures
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society

what we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in robotics, blockchain, additive manufacturing, and innovation management.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote in Germany or hybrid work from one of our offices in Hanover, Munich, or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours coordinated within your team (no weekend work) – doctor's appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are easy to accommodate
  • 15% employer contribution to your company pension plan
  • 3 paid Educational Days per year for professional development + 1 additional day of annual leave for volunteer work
  • Access to 13,000+ fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation

application documents and further information

  • Please submit your application, together with the required documents, in English via our online portal. You can access the online portal through the "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" button. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by post or email.
  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *:
    • *Cover letter
    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities
    • *List of publications and, where applicable, presentations

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $200/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.
